name: Lagoon Land
description: The proximity to these luxury marina communities puts Lagoon Land in the heart of the high-end residential hub of the Northwestern part of the Island. The plot gently slopes upward from the Caribbean Sea toward the East and its landscape allows for the development of a combination of residences including condominiums built around a man-made lake and elevated properties with views of the Caribbean Sea. Planning permission has been granted for the development of 200 units. The property is located in close proximity to Speightstown, with its fish market and amenities and also close to Holetown which hosts an array of shops, restaurants and bars making the property ideally situated.

name: The Ridge
description: The treasure trove of contents within the property has been skillfully selected over the past decade with many of the special and unique items having a strong connection to the Caribbean. Highlights include exceptionally rare film memorabilia such as Charlie Chaplin’s personal cane and a very rare vintage film poster collection, including an original for one of the few Hollywood movies to be shot in Barbados, Island in the Sun (1957) starring Harry Belafonte and Joan Collins. There are exceptionally rare furniture pieces by designers Carlo Bugatti and Viscount Linley, as well as incredibly scarce sketches from artist and designer Oliver Messel, who designed many of Barbados’ most illustrious houses. Alongside are works by celebrity photographer Terry O’Neill and the largest known Caribbean painting collection of English playwright Noel Coward, accompanied by works from world famous Russian-born French artist, Erte, who visited Barbados many times during his distinguished career.

name: Clifton Cove
description: Prime for redevelopment, Clifton Cove is an exceptional coastal estate set on over 30,000 sq. ft. of prime real estate along the prestigious West Coast of Barbados. With an impressive frontage along the Caribbean Sea, this site offers breathtaking 180-degree ocean views from its elevated perch atop a low coral cliff. Its depth and width provide an unparalleled canvas for a visionary new estate, making it one of the most compelling redevelopment opportunities in Barbados. While the existing Ian Morrison-designed residence has classic architectural appeal, the true value lies in the extraordinary potential of the land itself. The site is ideally suited for a modern coastal retreat or luxury villa estate, maximising the panoramic sea views and direct access to a secluded beach cove below.

name: Port St. Charles Penthouse
description: Barbados is ideally situated in the Caribbean south of the hurricane zone and 380 Port St. Charles is a perfect sanctuary to escape the prevailing uncertainties and risks of our time. It is a safe place to live. The island is a reputable jurisdiction always with a stable political, social and economic climate. The warm temperatures all year and air quality create a healthy environment for the many outdoor activities and world class amenities on offer. The business and fiscal regimes are also attractive with no capital gains taxes and a maximum income tax rate of 5%. The amazing and unspoilt Grenadine islands are a mere three hours away by sea for weekend getaways with St. Lucia and Antigua withing striking distances for longer cruises.

name: Octopus' Garden
description: Weston boasts one of the best addresses on the island's west coast, neighbouring some of the most exclusive villas in Barbados such as Mango Bay, Cove Spring, The Dream and Gardenia. Speightstown, a quieter town in the north of the island, maintains the charming architectural features of the past; with cozy beachfront cafes, art galleries and casual bars, it provides a relaxed atmosphere enjoyed by visitors and locals alike. Both towns have grocery shops, banks and post offices.

name: Holders House
description: Accessed by a tree-lined drive that leads to another world entirely; Holders House is set amongst five acres of formal gardens, gently sloping lawns, and tropical orchards. It offers a quiet serenity few can resist; the charming 17th century plantation home is surrounded by ancient Mahogany trees and features an aesthetically pleasing mix of traditional English and Barbadian architecture. While many newer homes emulate this style, Holders House is one of the few authentic plantation homes on the West Coast. Its layout takes advantage of the easterly Tradewinds breezes, and beautiful sea views can be enjoyed from the large coral stone sun deck and pool terraces, which also features a lovely dining gazebo with seating for 12.

name: Lazybones House
description: The mature gardens are a sculptural masterpiece, subtly lit at night within the lush green foliage. Rare exotic plans turn the garden into a romantic tropical Eden with teak bridges over Koi ponds connecting the living areas creating a seamless indoor-outdoor effect. Relax in an infinity-edged swimming pool framed by an ancient coral rock tower draped with bougainvillea. A waterfall trickles down from the ancient tower into the pool, flowing over a natural rock ledge creating the perfect spot for a romantic midnight swim. Spacious entertaining spaces with high ceilings overlook the Koi ponds and pool to blend the gardens and interior into a seamless vision. Equally as special is an elevated romantic dining pavilion comfortably seating ten, that overlooks the Caribbean Sea creating a setting for a memorable dining experience. A service/warming kitchen below supports the chef’s and butler’s duties.

name: Royal Westmoreland, Hibiscus Villas
description:
Starting From GBP$

This single level home keeps everybody happy with all four bedrooms facing the view and pool.

A fresh contemporary design with large sliding glass doors along the entire front of the home makes the most of the sun and light we enjoy all year round. As you enter into the foyer there is an office on the side as you walk through to a beautiful open plan living room and kitchen with outside dining and straight to the swimming pool. Two master suites on either end with large walk in wardrobes and private verandas create oasis of privacy in this open plan home. The two guest suites open out to the large veranda and back the cinema room and utility rooms. All bedrooms have en-suite bathrooms and of course a powder room for visitors. This is an easy living truly stunning home designed to be lived it and enjoyed.

name: Sugar Hill, Bananaquit
description:
Bananaquit is a luxury villa located in the exclusive Sugar Hill Estate. The property has been recently renovated and enjoys a prime position at the end of Plantation Drive, therefore increasing the privacy of the villa. The main house accommodates three bedrooms with the remaining two being in the detached cottage.

The villa is blessed with superb sea views from the entire first floor which boasts an open plan kitchen, spacious living room and media room. The entertaining areas expand into the large balcony offering outdoor dining and lounge areas overlooking the pool and gardens.

The three bedrooms are located on the ground floor and feature grand French doors leading out to the pool area. The pool deck is spacious and offers multiple uses besides having a refreshing swim including lounging in the sun, the sitting area under the terrace, wet bar, and BBQ.

The unique basement is complete with a second TV/games room with pool table, and table tennis.

Guest of Bananaquit also enjoy complimentary access to the amenities of the Sugar Hill Resort:

Holetown and the nearest Beach are a short 6-minute drive. While in Holetown you will have access to the shopping mall, supermarket, local arts, and craft (souvenirs) and plenty of dining options to choose from.

name: Cockade House
description:
Available May 15, 2025.

A truly unique private estate located east of Sandy Lane Estate, occupying approximately 5.5 acres of land, and offering great sea views across the Green Monkey golf course. The original Oliver Messel home was renovated and enhanced by Timothy Oulton. The renovations, overseen by Michael Gomes have added 3 new cottages and there is a total of 6 ensuite bedrooms. The property is surrounded by lands of Sandy Lane and the owners allow a well-known Cricket Academy to use the lower field of the property, complete with a professionally laid pitch and a Pavilion.

The main house retains the beautiful Palladian style of Messel's design and consists of a formal sitting room leading to informal sitting and dining. From here the garden and sea views are the focal point. There is an extensive master suite, a private terrace opening to the swimming pool, the master bath opens to a tropical outdoor shower room. Also in the main house is a 2nd bedroom, an office with sea views and a modern kitchen. The large swimming pool and surrounding terrace looks onto a "folly" a fishpond with coral stone ruin, another of Messel's creations.

There are 3 other cottages set within the beautifully landscaped gardens each with its own charming Barbadian design. Two of the cottages each have one bedroom, bathroom, and kitchenette facilities, the third cottage has two bedrooms and two bathrooms. Other buildings house a laundry and staff room, separate gardener's cottage, and a 2-car garage.

The rental rate includes garden and pool maintenance.

name: Apes Hill, The View
description:
Situated in the Apes Hill Resort, this property enjoys the cooling trade winds and spectacular views from its elevated position within the resort.  Built in 2017, this elegant, luxury villa features large windows and doors which allow a lot of natural light. The main level comprises the living, dining, and TV areas which all open onto the expansive patio and inviting pool area, offering ample outdoor living space, ideal for entertaining. The fully equipped, spacious kitchen and an ensuite bedroom are also on this level.

The upper level consists of 3 ensuite bedrooms. The master bathroom has marble countertops, a double sink, walk-in shower and stand-alone Jacuzzi tub and the master bedroom opens onto a patio with lovely views of the golf course.  The third bedroom leads into two large rooms ideal for an office and play area for the kids.

The lower level has two full bathrooms allowing for a further 2 bedrooms if need be. Additional rooms provide ample storage areas, a dedicated gym area, media room, games/lounging area for teenagers. There is an abundance of space at this property which is ideal for any family.

Pool and Garden Maintenance included.

name: Vaucluse House
description:
Behind the nondescript automatic entry gates sits a property that is truly unique. The eccentric fully furnished main house, has three bedrooms and two bathrooms. The impressive front hallway leads to the grand dining room, spacious living room and cosy den. The eat-in chef’s kitchen features a sub-zero fridge/freezer, a Vulcan range, a brick oven and easy access to the covered patio.

The covered patio is the perfect place to lounge by the bar having a cool drink, just steps away from the large pool below. The original custom-made furniture along with the stone walls, particular art and period features help to make this home one of a kind. There are ceiling fans throughout and AC in the bedrooms.

A must see!

name: Buchanan
description:
Available July 15th. Welcome to Buchanan, an elegant and fully furnished colonial-style home offering 3 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms in the main property and there are 2 separate cottages, with one bedroom each. The residence features spacious rooms with high ceilings, beautiful hardwood floors, and modern bathrooms and kitchen.

Step outside to a large patio that opens onto a full-sized 40 ft. pool and a heated 8-seater jacuzzi, perfect for relaxation or entertaining. The property spans approximately an acre of lush gardens and manicured lawns, complete with a charming gazebo and a covered pavilion equipped with a wet bar and BBQ grill for outdoor gatherings. Two delightful, self-contained cottages add additional bedroom suites for guests or extended family.

All bedrooms are air-conditioned for your comfort. Fitness enthusiasts will appreciate the state-of-the-art gym, featuring top-of-the-line Vectra equipment, specialized gym flooring, and a full bathroom—all air-conditioned for an optimal workout experience. Two dedicated home offices provide a peaceful work environment, while the air-conditioned living area is perfect for relaxation after a productive day.

Entertain in style in the formal dining room or enjoy casual mornings in the cozy breakfast nook. This exceptional property is truly designed for gracious living.

The rate includes pool and garden maintenance, and the price is inclusive of the gym equipment.

For more information or to schedule a viewing, please get in touch.

name: Aberdare
Saint Peter's Bay 305
description:
Set along the pristine coastline of Barbados’ Platinum Coast, this elegant 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence at Saint Peter’s Bay offers the ultimate in Caribbean luxury living. Positioned to capture breathtaking sea views, the home combines timeless Barbadian architecture with modern comfort and style.

Each spacious bedroom features its own en-suite bathroom, providing privacy and convenience for residents and guests alike. The open plan living, and dining areas flow effortlessly onto a private terrace, where panoramic views of the Caribbean Sea create a stunning backdrop for everyday living or entertaining.

Residents at Saint Peter’s Bay enjoy access to a range of world-class amenities, including a beachfront pool, full concierge service, 24-hour security, and direct beach access.

Perfect for discerning tenants seeking a refined island lifestyle. This fully appointed residence offers an exceptional long-term rental opportunity on Barbados' sought-after West Coast.

name: Port St. Charles 133
description:
This beautifully furnished 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom Villa is offered for rent or sale fully furnished and

sits on an island in the centre of the Port St. Charles Marina. The Villa has 3 floors with a penthouse master suite which includes a spacious bathroom, private balcony, and private lounge/study.

The 1st Floor has two large bedrooms both with ensuite bathrooms. These rooms have stunning views of the marina. The ground floor has a lovely kitchen, powder room, dining room and lounge which open onto a patio. There is direct access from the property to a 50ft dock. The Villa has two covered parking spaces.

This luxury Estate boasts many amenities including a water taxi, tennis courts, fitness centre, community pool and direct beach access with complimentary sun beds and umbrellas. Residents have easy access to Pier One restaurant.

The Rental Rate US$6,750.00 (BDS$13,500.00) ONO per month plus utilities.
features: Positioned in the centre of The Lagoon

name: Marine Gardens, Coryston
description:
Nestled in the prestigious Marine Gardens neighbourhood of Hastings, Christ Church, this exquisite family home is the epitome of elegance, comfort, and convenience—ideal for executive rentals or families seeking a seamless transition to island life.

Step into a beautifully appointed 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom main house, complete with a Granny Suite for added flexibility. Designed for both work and relaxation, the home features two private offices, ensuring productivity without compromise. Each bedroom is fully air-conditioned, providing a cool oasis in Barbados' tropical warmth.

Outside, the expansive manicured grounds, private pool, and dedicated gym area invite you to unwind or entertain in style. Whether it’s a morning workout or an afternoon dip, this space is designed to enhance your well-being.

Located just seconds from the lively boardwalk yet perfectly tucked away in an established and secure neighbourhood, this home offers the best of both worlds—proximity to island activities, restaurants, and entertainment, while maintaining peace and privacy.

The property is available for a 12-month lease, with the option to extend, and tenants are responsible for utilities, pool, and garden maintenance.

name: Lemonade
description:
This stunning beachfront property offers a spacious and comfortable living space with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The home is fully furnished, providing everything you need to feel right at home. With 2,100 square feet of living space, there is plenty of room for your family and friends to relax and unwind.

The fully equipped kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a 7-seater table for entertaining guests. The bedrooms are beautifully furnished with comfortable beds and ample storage space.

Outside, you'll find a charming patio area with outdoor furniture and a barbecue grill, perfect for al fresco dining or simply relaxing and soaking up the sun.

The property is child and pet-friendly, making it the perfect destination for families. With breathtaking ocean views and easy access to the beach.

Don't miss out on the opportunity to experience beachfront living at its finest!

*Cottage not included*

name: Frere Pilgrim 9
description:
Frere Pilgrim 9 is an extraordinary executive rental located in a tranquil cul-de-sac within a central, well-established neighborhood. The property welcomes you through a courtyard that leads to impeccably maintained marble floors and breathtaking views that seem like they belong in a dream. The sitting room, dining area, open-air living room, and patio are all connected by an open-plan layout, creating the ideal space for entertaining guests. Off to the West Wing, you’ll find a spacious kitchen brimming with storage and equipped with appliances, a powder room, and a versatile multi-use room that could serve as a TV lounge, office, or personal gym.

The bedrooms are in the East Wing, just a few steps up from the sitting area. The master bedroom is expansive, featuring a walk-in closet, an en-suite bathroom, complete with shower and tub, and an open-air sitting room with a privacy lattice for serene relaxation. The two additional en-suite bedrooms boast built-in cupboards, air conditioning, and ceiling fans for added comfort. An additional bonus room on this wing offers flexibility as a small bedroom, office, or nursery. A built-in cubby space with extra freezer capacity adds to the home’s functional features.

Convenience is woven seamlessly into the property’s design, with a double car garage featuring automatic doors located beneath the bedrooms. Adjacent to the garage, the staff quarters include laundry facilities, a small kitchen, and a fully equipped living space with a bathroom and bedroom, which can double as additional storage.

The outdoor space elevates the property to a level of pure delight. A large pool and gazebo are situated at the front of the house, where the original owners often spent time dining under the stars. The gardens, fully enclosed and meticulously kept, complete the outdoor experience with beauty and privacy.

This impressive property is available for rent partially furnished. Rental includes pool maintenance, garden upkeep, and pest control. Pets are welcome, ensuring your entire family feels right at home in this spectacular setting.

#9 Frere Pilgrim is a truly special offering, ready to become your personal paradise.

name: Sunset Ridge 32
description:
Mahogany Avenue 32 – Barbados West Coast Rental with Private Pool

Mahogany Avenue 32 is a fully furnished 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home available for rent in Sunset Ridge, one of Barbados’ most desirable neighbourhoods on the West Coast. This property is perfect for anyone seeking a well-maintained home with modern conveniences and easy access to beaches, dining, and essential amenities.

This rental home features a 26-foot private swimming pool surrounded by lush, professionally landscaped gardens that offer tranquility and privacy. The large, covered patio provides the perfect space for outdoor dining, relaxing, or hosting guests. The home includes three spacious bedrooms with modern bathrooms, a functional layout, and fully furnished interiors designed for comfortable living.

Located minutes from some of the best beaches in Barbados, including Mullins Beach and Paynes Bay, as well as renowned restaurants and shopping, Mahogany Avenue 32 ensures a lifestyle of convenience and accessibility. Sunset Ridge offers a peaceful residential setting that balances privacy with proximity to the vibrant attractions of the West Coast.

Property Highlights :

• Fully furnished 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home with spacious interiors

• Private 26-foot pool and covered outdoor patio

• Lush, landscaped gardens professionally maintained

• Convenient location near Barbados’ best beaches, restaurants, and shopping

Included in the Rental :

• Garden maintenance

• Pool servicing

• Housekeeping

Utilities are the tenant’s responsibility, offering flexibility and control over monthly expenses.

This property is ideal for anyone looking to enjoy the benefits of a fully furnished, move-in-ready home in a prime location. Mahogany Avenue 32 combines space, functionality, and an excellent location, making it a standout choice for living on Barbados’ West Coast.

description:
This beautifully furnished, top-floor 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom condo is set within one of Barbados’ most sought-after gated communities, offering a perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience.

Step inside to find a modern kitchen equipped with quality appliances, including a dishwasher, which flows seamlessly into a spacious open plan living and dining area. High cathedral ceilings add an airy elegance, while large doors open to a sheltered patio with breathtaking distant views over the south coast and St. George Valley—perfect for relaxing or entertaining.

The master suite measures approximately 14’ x 13’ and features a queen bed, en suite bathroom with a shower, and cooling comfort from both ceiling fans and air-conditioning. The second bedroom, around 12’ x 11’, is furnished with two single beds and an en suite with a bathtub. A stylish powder room is provided for guests, and a convenient laundry area houses a stackable washer/dryer and sink.

Enjoy the exceptional shared facilities of this expansive community, including two large swimming pools, two lit tennis courts, a clubhouse with a gym, and a scenic walking track.

The vibrant hub of Warrens, with its shopping, dining, and services, is just minutes away, as are the prestigious Sandy Lane Golf Course and the stunning beaches of Barbados’ west coast.

This is island living at its finest—beautifully appointed, superbly located, and ready to be enjoyed.

description:
Available until Feb 28 th , 2025, and available for a minimum of a 1-month rental.

Enjoy the sunny season in style! Newly built and super modern townhouse nestled on the South Coast of Barbados. This bright, spacious townhouse in one of the newest developments 'Harmony Hall Green', is perfect for working remotely and living comfortably for your stay. The property comes fully furnished with all the bells and whistles and is 100% turnkey. It is air conditioned throughout and furnished with ceiling fans, screened windows and multimedia entertainment.

The ground floor comprises a fully equipped modern kitchen, powder room and open plan living space, leading to the tropical courtyard setting where a reflecting pool laps at the edge of the private covered patio. All of the spacious bedrooms are upstairs. The large primary bedroom has an ensuite bathroom, built in closets and a private balcony overlooking the lush courtyard, perfect for a peaceful morning coffee in the beautiful Barbados sun. The guest bedroom has a king bed/twin beds along with built in closets, and there is a fully equipped ergonomic office with a queen size Murphy wall bed. There is also a swimming pool and sun deck in the development. Additional features include a safe, alarm system, and security on site. This rental includes utilities along with biweekly housekeeping. The townhouse may be rented as two bedrooms plus a fully equipped office or as 3 bedrooms and includes 2 parking spaces.

Ideally situated on the island, the location is peaceful, yet close to the nightlife of St. Lawrence Gap and Oistins Fish Fry. At the intersection of the ABC Highway and the South Coast's main road, getting around by car or public transportation is easy. It is a 5-minute walk to spectacular Dover Beach and conveniently located close to a range of shopping, including groceries, specialty food and wine, fresh local produce and fish.

name: Williams One Offices
Imagine
Satjay Mall
description:
Given the highly competitive nature of the local and international business environment, Satjay Bridgetown Centre offers a unique opportunity to provide an expansive area (20,000 sq. ft.) of air-conditioned commercial office and retail space in its modern two storied complex in the heart of Bridgetown, located behind Cave Shepherd building on Victoria Street, encompassing a frontage of more than Cave Shepherd and Norman Center combined.

The available 20,000 sq. ft. area on two floors consist of the following:

Ground Floor - 2,500 sq. ft. Lower Mezzanine - 1,897 sq. ft. First Floor - 15,073 sq. ft. Total: 19,470 sq. ft.

The annual rental rate is $40.00 per sq. ft. or $3.33 per sq. ft. per month, with the Tenant being responsible for air-conditioning, electricity, water and gas.

The tenant would benefit from Duty Free on Leasehold improvements, subject to the provisions of the Special Development Area Act whereby all imported materials used for Leasehold improvements within the leased premises shall benefit from concessions. The Landlord shall provide certificates to the Comptroller of Customs based on invoices and shipping documents provided by the tenant. The landlord is prepared to assist in some small way in defraying a small portion of the set up leasehold improvements via a credit against the rent over time.

This is an excellent opportunity for Offshore Banks, Insurance companies, Government agencies and offices, enterprises involved in furniture or electronics and appliance sales, and other retail clothing or hardware items.

name: The Great House
Seaclusion
description:
The property Seaclusion is an outstanding six bedroom beachfront luxury villa in Barbados which sits on one acre of tropical gardens on a bluff, overlooking the beach and Caribbean Sea. This extraordinary high end home features unparalleled sea views from all living areas and 5 of the bedrooms.

The elegantly furnished interiors also include a cocktail bar, living and reception areas and media room. There is also a formal dining room, entertaining kitchen, grand piano and fitness room. The main house has four bedroom suites each with a terrace or balcony. A stunning spiral staircase leads to the master suite on the upper level. The master also includes a private terrace, walk in wardrobes and mesmerizing sea views.

In addition, there is a further bedroom in a self contained apartment cottage which is perfect for those traveling with staff or teenage children.

Enjoy outdoor living on the wide sea facing terrace which boasts a cocktail bar, ideal for entertaining, or guests can enjoy the ocean front gazebo with informal dining. The one of a kind infinity edge lap pool has a built in bar table and sunken seats an ideal setting for unforgettable sundowners. The impeccable grounds include magnificent zen gardens, koi fish pond and private access to a secluded beach. The villa comes fully staffed with butler, chef, housekeeper and laundress and is supported by round the clock security, property management and concierge.

Children are accepted by request only.
features: Private Beachfront  set on a Bluff

name: Kiko Villa
description:
This luxurious 4 storey coral stone Villa located on the stunning Paynes Bay Beach on the exclusive Platinum West Coast in the Parish of St. James.

The property boasts 9 spacious beach-front, uniquely styled bedrooms all with private balconies, with décor to reflect the calm Caribbean Sea.

Offering the ultimate in beachfront luxury with the added benefit of a private setting, Kiko is the perfect venue for making memories. From family vacations to tropical weddings and special celebrations, it is the ideal choice for larger groups of up to 20 and those seeking a discreet, more intimate holiday retreat.

From the breathtaking views over the warm turquoise waters of the Caribbean, to the superbly appointed accommodation and elegant interiors, Kiko creates a welcoming and relaxing ambience that is designed to soothe the senses.

The villa’s many superb amenities include a stunning 25m saltwater pool, state-of-the-art cinema, games room, high-tech fitness centre and health spa where guests can enjoy a wide variety of indulgent treatments.

Further enhancing your stay, Kiko’s dedicated guest relations who are on hand to cater for your every need and ensure your stay is truly memorable.

Experience paradise at Kiko – we look forward to welcoming you.

name: One Beachlands
description:
We are proud to offer for vacation rental the extraordinary, beachfront villa, One Beachlands, located on the beautiful West Coast of Barbados. This brand-new mansion-size, luxurious property has been designed to expand the possibilities of elite architecture and ultramodern luxury living.

The villa spans two floors and includes impressive international brands, superb fittings, and luxurious materials. The completely bespoke exterior is dominated by full height windows with astonishing Caribbean Sea views. With six expansive ocean-facing bedrooms the villa is perfect for families or those who love to host guests.

This astonishing luxury home has been designed to cater for entertainment and indoor-outdoor living. Unique features include the ocean-facing private gym and home cinema. It is also fitted with an integrated smart home automation system for optimum convenience.

Outside, the splendor of the villa continues with a 75ft long infinity swimming pool, open to unobstructed Caribbean Sea views. At either end of the pool, two pavilions provide the perfect place for afternoon relaxation or hosting family events. From the garden, guests can step out to the warm Caribbean waters to enjoy tropical snorkeling.

The mansion-like carriage-entrance features a unique water feature and koi pond.

Breathtaking design and unbeatable location, make One Beachlands a truly one-of-a-kind, luxury property.
features: Essential services and Amenities at your Doorstep

name: Villa Tamarindo
description:
Welcome to Villa Tamarindo, a stunning five-bedroom villa located at one of the best locations in Barbados. This villa is a beautiful and luxurious two-storey property set on four and a half acres in the exclusive and popular villas at Beachlands. This villa is ideal for guests looking for luxury comfort and a perfect island location. Enjoy all that Barbados has to offer from the beaches to the food and luxury.

This magnificent villa has been designed by renowned local architect Larry Warren. The design of this property incorporates traditional Caribbean architecture with world-class contemporary interiors. The property exemplifies luxury, elegance and comfort, all the things that make for an exquisite villa.

The home also benefits from wonderful indoor and outdoor spaces for both living and entertaining. The 44ft swimming pool and terrace are slightly raised from the beachfront providing privacy and making your stay more comfortable. Enjoy spending time with your family and friends in this beautiful location. Make memories to last a lifetime at Villa Tamarindo.

Contemporary interiors seamlessly spread across the villa which features five-bedroom suites, five bathrooms and two powder rooms. This villa is great for families or groups of friends. Enjoy each other’s company while taking in the stunning surroundings of Barbados. The villa sits against a backdrop of carefully landscaped grounds for guests to escape and relax expansive beach views visible from almost every room.

Each en suite bedroom is also fully air-conditioned and offers unrestricted panoramic views of the spectacular blue ocean from an expansive terrace and sundeck. Relax with a cup of coffee in the morning as you watch the stunning sunrise. The en suite bathrooms all feature unrivalled finishes. Within the property, there is also a gym, media room and high-specification chef’s kitchen where a private chef can cater to your every need. You won’t have to leave the comfort of your beautiful home if you do not wish. Everything you need to enjoy the ultimate island experience is made readily available to you.

This home is private, fully enclosed and gated, with a state-of-the-art security system and nightly security service in place. Enjoy comfort and peace at its finest at Villa Tamarindo. Restaurants and amenities of Holetown and Limegrove Lifestyle Centre are just a short drive away.

name: Godings Beach House
description:
Situated on the prestigious Platinum Coast of Barbados, in the parish of St. Peter, this 5 bedroom, luxury beach villa offers up to ten guests the ultimate in contemporary luxury. Stylish décor and clean lines work in harmony with the prime, beachfront location, offering the perfect retreat for rest and relaxation.

Measuring over 13,500 sq. ft., this luxury Barbados villa boasts a sleek and contemporary design - the work of local award-winning architects Gillespie & Steel - and uses some of the island’s most beautiful materials. The clever design brings the outside in, so you can enjoy incredible views of your infinity pool and the sea beyond from the comfort of your spacious, open plan living area.

Gated and private, your luxury beach villa combines modern comforts with stylish living. From the Boffi kitchen and designer furnishings – think Ralph Lauren and Christian Liaigre - to the 5 en suite bedrooms with sea-facing terraces, no expense has been spared to ensure a stay at Godings Beach House is truly special. There’s even a state-of-the-art gym, glass-walled study and home cinema room, not to mention a range of top-end water sports equipment.

A team of professional staff is on hand at your Barbados villa to tend to your every need. Your private cook will tailor menus to your exact taste, while your house manager can arrange everything from unforgettable dining experiences at some of the island’s most exclusive restaurants, to sunrise yoga sessions and stand-up paddle boarding adventures.

A double staircase with feature Verpan seashell chandelier leads upstairs to five spacious en suite bedrooms. A few have four-poster beds dressed with white linen, and all have American oak flooring, Ralph Lauren bed stools and a smattering of other unique design pieces. Each bedroom has a walk-in dressing room, private terrace and luxury bathroom furnished with Hansgrohe rain shower, mosaic tiles from Ann Sacks and marble vanities. The master suite’s large bathtub sits at the base of a floor-to-ceiling window offering sweeping garden views down to the beach.

The main entrance with Holly Hunt consoles leads to the living area which is open plan and spacious with neutral tones, pale limestone flooring and an impressive local coral feature wall. Large windows make the most of the surrounding sea and pool views. The living and dining areas are furnished with designer pieces from the likes of Maxalto, Christian Liaigre and Ralph Lauren as well as a pair of B&B Italia sofas.

The stylish Boffi kitchen is fully equipped with all mod cons, a large breakfast table and a wall-mounted TV. There are a few dining options to choose from. Dine inside, around the grand bespoke Whetstone Oak dining table, or al fresco, on one of two shaded dining areas for delicious lazy lunches or an evening BBQ under the stars. Your personal cook will be happy to tailor menus to your party’s preferences, using the designated chef's kitchen.

The house also offers a glass-walled study, a state-of-the-art gym and a media room where film fans can enjoy access to every movie on iTunes and Netflix, streamed directly from their iPad or iPhone to a large cinema screen. These rooms boast stunning coastal art pieces by Nicola Bealing, from Cornwall, and Guy Leclef. Sonos is also available in all main rooms for music streaming.

Godings Beach House sits in approximately 1.2 acres of landscaped gardens, featuring two shaded dining areas and a yoga pavilion. With plenty of spots to enjoy a perfectly mixed cocktail, palm trees and scented shrubs scatter the grounds, with a pebbled path leading directly to a protected beach where you might be lucky enough to witness newly hatched turtles making their way to the sea. For healthy infusions, pepping up salads, or botanical cocktails, the herb and Caribbean spice garden is brimming with fresh mint, basil, coriander and ginger.

The sleek 25m mosaic-lined pool is perfect for early morning laps, surrounded by limestone tiles and comfy sun loungers where you can relax during the day with a good book.

Property Policies

No Pets Please

Non-smoking Policy

Child friendly

name: Sandy Lane, Landfall House
description:
Landfall House is located on the beautiful platinum west coast of Barbados with Sandy Lane Beach on Landfall’s doorstep. This tranquil and secluded white sand stretch of beach takes its name from the Sandy Lane hotel that occupies the southern end of the cove. Except for the prestigious Sandy Lane Hotel only four other properties, including Landfall can boast this premier position on Sandy Lane beach.

This very spacious 6-bedroom property provides the ultimate in villa luxury. From the moment one enters the central courtyard with its cascading tropical flowers and bubbling fountain, the enticement to see more ensues.

The ground floor reveals two spacious bedrooms, a gazebo, dining room and a spacious indoor living area overlooking the pool and stunning beach. A sunken living room with numerous comfortable sofas and lounges provides a place to relax in cool surroundings.

On the First Floor, a magnificent master suite with adjoining balcony awaits you, as well as three equally splendid bedrooms, all air-conditioned with en suite bathrooms, providing ample accommodation for larger groups. There is also an upstairs lounge, offering another quiet haven. This unique property is ideal for entertaining - accommodating sunset cocktails in the jacuzzi, midday lunch parties around the swimming pool and starlit barbeques on the beach.

This privately owned villa is let complete, with all equipment and utilities, and is run by trained staff consisting of a security guard, butler, two maids, cook, laundress and gardener. Babysitters can be provided on request and supplies of food and drink can also be provided with prior notice.

Landfall adjacent to the Sandy Lane Estate and Golf Course is a short walk from historic Holetown where there are traditional shops at the Chattel House Village; Limegrove Lifestyle Centre - full of premium international designer brands including Ralph Lauren, Gucci, etc., banks, a post office; a supermarket,

Convenience store & gas station; a police station, and a 24-hour medical facility. In addition, there is an array of fast food & exceptional fine-dining restaurants & bars, such as, The Tides, Nishi, Fusion Rooftop, QP Bistro and The Cliff.

Additional Information & Policies :

A 55” TV added to the bar sitting area

Cable service with all the major USA Networks and a complete sports package - American/UK football, Tennis, Golf etc.

Furnished Gazebo to make a new outdoor lounge

Non-smoking Policy

Child friendly

No Pets Allowed

Accessible
features: Indoor Bar and Outdoor Living area
Sound System to Outdoor areas & Bar
Satellite TVs in every bedroom, the bar and in the TV-room
Al fresco Dining within touching distance of the beach
Master Suite with private Balcony overlooking the Sea

name: Sandy Lane, Second Thought
description:
Welcome to Second Thought, a beautiful villa on the prestigious Sandy Lane Estate.

Second Thought sits on over 6 acres of lush, private gardens complete with a palm thatched dining gazebo, serene ponds, and a quaint bridge.

There are a total of 6 suites in this charming villa. Two spacious master suites with private balconies are found on the upper floor while the remaining guests suites, each with en-suite bathrooms, are on the ground floor and offer direct access to the pool area and gardens.

Step into the drawing and dining room, where you’ll be greeted by breathtaking views of the junior Olympic size pool. Adjacent to this inviting space is a gourmet kitchen, perfect for culinary enthusiasts. The family room provides ample space for various activities or simply a cool retreat.

At the heart of it all is the stunning swimming pool and the surrounding patio which sets the stage for family gatherings and intimate dinners. Additionally, the pool pavilion offers a shaded oasis for afternoon refreshments or energizing morning workouts.

Private and tranquil, Second Thought offers the perfect oasis for peaceful family getaways.

Property Policies: Non-smoking Policy / Child friendly / No Pets Please

name: Sandy Lane, Villa Aama
description:
Situated on the exclusive Sandy Lane Estate this elegant villa overlooks the 3rd Fairway and offers private access to the beach club located adjacent to the Sandy Lane Hotel.

Recently renovated, the open plan living and dining areas open on to the large pool terrace and the lush gardens beyond. Three air-conditioned guest suites are positioned on this level along with a family/media room, formal dining room, kitchen and staff area / laundry.

Situated upstairs are 2 master and 2 guest bedrooms with each bedroom having its own en-suite bathroom and private patios which overlook the pool, beautifully landscaped gardens and golf course respectively.

Villa Aama is within easy access to shopping, restaurants and other amenities on the west coast of the island.

Note: Weddings and small events are allowed on a request basis at an additional cost with a maximun of 75 Guests.

name: Blue Oyster Villa
description:
Located in a prime beachfront location, this magnificent property is the perfect balance between luxury and comfort. With five generously sized bedrooms and five modern bathrooms, it offers ample space for families to enjoy a truly unforgettable vacation.

As you step into the open-plan living area, you'll be struck by the breathtaking view. With plenty of space for entertaining guests, this home is perfect for relaxing with loved ones.

Boasting sleek finishes throughout, this recently renovated property exudes sophistication and style. Every corner of this home has been meticulously designed to create a sense of harmony and balance that will leave you feeling rejuvenated and revitalized.

The beautiful pool is undoubtedly one of the standout features of this stunning property. Surrounded by lush greenery and complete with a poolside gazebo, it provides the ultimate for relaxation and entertainment. Whether you're looking to soak up some sun or enjoy an al fresco meal with friends and family, this outdoor oasis is sure to impress.

As night falls, retreat to one of the five luxurious bedrooms, each one offering its own unique charm and character. With an abundance of natural light flooding in through large windows, every room in this home has been designed to create a sense of peace and tranquillity that will leave you feeling refreshed and rejuvenated.

In short, this beachfront oasis offers modern style living at its finest. From the beautiful interiors to the stunning outdoor spaces, everything about this has been crafted to create an unforgettable experience that will stay with you long after your stay has ended.

Note Property Policies:

name: Sandalo
description:
This stunning five-bedroom home is conveniently located with private access to Gibbs Beach. Boasting an extensive terrace surrounded by lush tropical vegetation, you will have no problem finding the perfect spot to relax on a lounge chair, and if you need a little extra shade, head under one of the sun umbrellas. The in-ground pool sits in the center of the terrace and is perfect for cooling off after a little sunbathing. Enjoy an alfresco meal out in the gazebo, it's located just off the terrace and is furnished with a large dining table. If you're looking to enjoy a bit of downtime indoors, the villa also boasts a large media room equipped with surround sound and a plasma TV.

The interior of the spacious two-level villa home featuring coral-stone walls, marble flooring, high-end furnishings, and local Caribbean artwork. The living room leads out to the terrace and offers elegant sofas and armchairs as well as tasteful home accents. Bright and modern, the fully equipped kitchen boasts custom-designed cabinets, a dining table with seating for 10 and is fully air conditioned.

A maximum of 10 guests can stay in this villa’s five bedrooms; four are found in the main house while the remaining suite is located in a separate cottage. The main home’s bedrooms are located on the upper level and three include private balconies with pool, garden and sea views. All bedrooms offer a private en-suite bathroom and air conditioning.

Just steps away, the white sands of Gibbs Beach can be accessed from a private gate on the property. It’s a perfect spot to while away a day relaxing on one of the beach area’s comfy lounge chairs watching the waves.

  Property Policies

Non-smoking Policy

No Pets Please

name: La Maison Michelle
description:
Perched on Lancaster Ridge above the Platinum Coast this distinctive villa has been expertly designed to capture cooling breezes and astounding scenery from the flowing fields out to the timeless Caribbean Sea. La Maison Michelle is unique in every way from the concept layout, themed bedrooms, roof terraces and a fully staffed team. This is one of the few private vacation homes to offer a meal inclusive rate.

Situated on the famed “Platinum Coast” of Barbados’ western shores, the Barbados luxury spa property La Maison Michelle ushers in a new era of elegance in villa vacation leisure. It is a distinctive split-level home expertly designed from individually themed bedrooms to unique art & decor not seen at any other luxury Caribbean villa. From the moment you pass through the grand wrought-iron gates, you will be immediately aware of having been transported to another world; one of luxurious accommodations, stunningly evocative views, and experiences to soothe the mind, body, and soul. We cater to your every need.

Upon entering the villa on the first floor is the entrance hall, displaying an elegant chandelier, lovely painted abstract design on the concrete finished floor and of course the wide-open window with views of the sea down to the second wing of the villa. From this wing one can access three bedrooms. To the left is the lively Glass & Mirror Suite with an intricate block ceiling design, walk in closet, en suite, black-tiled bathroom including shower and outdoor Jacuzzi. The energetic Caribbean Suite is situated to the right of this wing with miniature steel pan fixtures and vibrant colours. An en suite bathroom provides a standing shower.

Further to the right of this wing is the Master Bedroom also known as the Shell Suite. As the name implies this room has neutral colours and furniture pieces adorned with shells. A separate walk-in closet and en suite bathroom consisting of tub and an open shower can also be found. These three rooms afford sea views and constant breezes from their private terraces. The further two bedrooms are located on the ground floor accessible via a three-way split staircase fitted with a crystal glass lit backdrop.

On the ground floor is The Ocean Suite, comprising of two twin beds and en suite bathroom with a standing shower and closet area to the left. The final room is a must see! Situated across the second wing of the villa and accessed via the courtyard is the Safari Suite - the epitome of jungle fever accentuated by a large wardrobe painted with safari animals such as elephants, giraffes, and other exotic animals. The spacious en suite bathroom has an exposed natural piece of coral stone created as part of the original foundation of the land. The coral stone adds an earthy effect to the already well themed bathroom complemented by a granite 'cheetah' print countertop, open shower and warm wood tiles. This room also features a small terrace ideal for enjoying an early morning coffee whilst embracing garden and sea views.

The courtyard also leads to the Media Room, equipped with comfy leather chairs and large screen where guests can enjoy on demand movies and internet TV in this relaxing air-conditioned room.

Through the tiled covered pathway is the open plan living room and expertly designed kitchen with an island and table seating up to 4 persons. Equipped with a stove top, oven, wine cooler, fridge, ice maker, dishwasher and more, the kitchen complete for a vacation away from home.

From the living room and kitchen one can access the outdoor area. An expansive split-level terrace is set up for lounging and informal dining. To the left and right of the terrace are separate elevated gazebos perfect for al fresco served by the Butler. The terrace and gazebos look out on to the large art deco infinity edge pool, sun deck with loungers and a small, sanded area set up as your very own private beach in Barbados, all achieving breathtaking scenery from flowing fields out to the azure Caribbean waters.

Further views can be enjoyed from one of the three roof terraces outfitted with seating and accessed via a spiral staircase in the courtyard.

La Maison Michelle features a fully functional Savant Home System, allowing for our guests to have full, easy control of lighting, climate, entertainment, privacy, and more from easy to access controllers located around the home.

A two-bedroom self-contained cottage offers The Platinum Suite with a Murphy King sized bed and The Cosmo Suite with a King-sized bedroom both with en suite bathrooms with walk-in closet. The cottage includes a separate kitchen and common deck.

Barbados Sotheby's International Realty Concierge is always happy to advise and make reservations on our guests’ behalf.

As a Beach Club member at the Fairmont Royal Pavilion (5 minutes away), all of our guests will enjoy the privacy of this beach club and their amenities (complimentary beach chairs and umbrellas plus food and drink service) daily. Enhanced health and safety protocols implemented.

Welcome Package: All bedrooms are en-suite.  Includes Chef-prepared Arrival Dinner and Brunch the next morning.  Also, our dedicated and pampering staff which consists of an executive chef (that will prepare your purchased groceries for the other days), butler, butler assistant, housekeepers, and night watchman. Private Beach Club Access daily*.
features: Terrace overlooks the large infinity-edge pool
Indoor dining plus outdoor dining in the spacious gazebo
Exclusive Golf & Spa Packages available at an additional cost

Unobstructed panoramic views of the azure waters from multiple spaces

name: Sandy Lane Estate, Tradewinds
description:
Tradewinds at Sandy Lane Estate is a striking five-bedroom mansion within the prestigious Sandy Lane Estate. Spacious, luxurious and private - an ideal getaway for friends or family.

This property's pool area is truly the focal point, surrounded by the villa's ground floor, a charming pagoda, and a cosy dining pavilion. You can easily while away the hours swimming in the elegant pool, basking in the sun, unwinding in the pagoda, or indulging in delicious meals in the pavilion. Step inside the main house and you'll find a covered terrace leading to a formal living room that exudes elegance with its high ceilings, light colour scheme, and expansive wall opening to the outdoors. It's a dreamy spot to relax and unwind in style.

Prepare to be amazed by the chic and sophisticated design of this property, where every corner exudes elegance and charm. The kitchen, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and sleek finishes, is a culinary enthusiast's dream. While guests may be tempted to try their hand at cooking up a storm, the villa offers the services of a skilled chef and efficient housekeeper to ensure a stress-free and luxurious stay. So, sit back, relax, and let the professionals take care of all your needs while you bask in the lap of luxury.

Step inside the indoor media room for some quality family time or just kick back and listen to your favourite tunes. And if you need a change of scenery, head to the private beach or hit the community tennis courts for a game or two. The five spacious bedrooms are tastefully decorated and offer plenty of privacy. Four are conveniently located on the ground floor with easy outdoor access, while the master bedroom encompasses the entire top floor with two balconies on each side. Each bedroom comes with a king bed and a lavish en suite bathroom featuring top-of-the-line fixtures and materials.

Just minutes from beautiful West Coast beaches, guests of Tradewinds will have access to the Sandy Lane Estate Beach Club's private cabana, tennis courts and golf course. As well as access to watersports, storage, cabana fridge/freezer, drinks and food, guests have access to the villa's private golf cart which is available for the short ride down to the club. Also close by Sandy Lane Estate are waterfront restaurants, boutiques, duty-free shopping and beach bars.

Additional Information:

Golf cart is only permitted for use to and from Sandy Lane Estate Beach Club for driver over 18 years old.

Policy Rules :

 No Pets

Smoking - Outside Only
amenities: Beach cabana on Sandy Lane Beach
features: Guest Access to Private Golf Cart
Easy Access to several West coast Amenities

name: Nelson Gay
description:
A stay at Nelson Gay unveils six decades of charm and sophistication presented on two acres of mature and immaculately lush gardens. Located on a beautiful half-mile of beach on the outskirts of Speightstown, its surrounding waters and reef are a playground for swimmers and snorkelers.

The purely coralline creation was originally built as the home of a United States Ambassador in the 1950s, and reflects a Palladian grandeur with 14-foot ceilings in the living room. To add to this, the villa's stunning 50-foot pool features testudine décor, and is positioned like a path from the centre of the house that summons the sea on its farthest end.

This family-friendly villa has a bounty of restful spaces and formal or al fresco dining areas, including a delightful option to dine by candlelight. The dwelling features a predominantly white canvas - a compliment to the tropical landscape - and is accentuated with several unique pieces and antiques. The sleeping quarters are remarkably fresh and airy, with comfortable beds, quality cotton sheets and hypoallergenic pillows.

Further outside are two charming chattel houses, as well as an elegant garden gazebo complete with a wet bar. Two covered terraces on the north and south wing bedrooms offer additional privacy and comfort, while on the seaside, a large area in front of the house is roped off with buoys for safe swimming.

The Villa Manager and their diligent staff are fully dedicated to your needs during your stay, and will craft fond memories for you at Nelson Gay.

Additional Information:

Media room serves as additional accommodation with day bed and roll away beds (available for rent)

Master Bedrooms can accommodate additional person in roll away bed (available for rent)

Some of the additional accommodation is only suitable for children

Entertainment:

Chattel House 2
