name: Smugglers Cove 7, The Penthouse
description:
Experience the ultimate luxury at Smugglers Cove Penthouse - an exclusive beachfront haven on Barbados' iconic West Coast. This top-floor, 4-bedroom apartment with a media room is your ticket to an unforgettable holiday in paradise. Indulge in over 6,000 square feet of sheer opulence, complete with breathtaking panoramic sea views. Immerse yourself in the grandeur of vaulted ceilings, exquisite marble floors, and state-of-the-art amenities. The modern kitchen and lavish bathrooms will leave you in awe.

With four generously sized air-conditioned bedrooms, accommodating up to eight guests, your comfort is paramount. Three bedrooms feature king-size beds, while the fourth offers the flexibility of two twin beds or a King. Each bedroom boasts a private en-suite bathroom with a shower, and three even include a luxurious bathtub. There is also a well-equipped media room with a pull-out sofa just off the living area that can be accommodated for an additional charge.

But that's not all - step onto the expansive 60-foot terrace adorned with stylish Italian loungers and a private Jacuzzi pool. Feel the gentle ocean breeze as you soak up the sun and revel in pure bliss.

Located on the pristine shores of Paynes Bay Beach, you'll have direct access to one of the island's most coveted sandy stretches. Plus, with restaurants, nightlife, shops, spas, and golf just moments away, the Platinum Coast awaits your exploration. Unleash your inner luxury-seeker at Smugglers Cove Penthouse.
features: Heated Plunge Pool on the Terrace
Golf moments away on the Platinum Coast
Several easy accessible Amenities: restaurants, nightlife, shops, spas on Platinum Coast

name: Sandy Lane, Aliseo
description:
“Welcome to Aliseo, Sandy Lane”

Said with a gracious smile, as I am led through the foyer of this magnificent villa on the island’s Platinum Coast. Italian in origin, the name “Aliseo” translates to mean “Tradewind” in English, and as its name suggests, this property is a breath of fresh air.

This beautiful tropical villa, complete with 9 en suite bedrooms capable of sleeping up to 18 persons, is ideal for the perfect family vacation. Situated high atop the picturesque Sandy Lane Estate, the property is run like an exclusive boutique hotel, and maintains extremely high standards on par with its elite location. A testament to this, on my arrival I am greeted by the gracious and un-assuming Butler of the property. As is his duty to fulfill all requests by the patrons of Aliseo, all requests no matter how small are swiftly and efficiently dealt with, from organising a personal trainer to a yoga or pilates expert, or an in-house spa experience, encompassing the full spectrum of treatments, a cocktail party or customized island tour with picnic, the butler goes above and beyond to ensure the satisfaction of his guests; he does it all with an easy grace, his sweet manner making life at Aliseo just that extra bit special.

On my personal guided tour of the property, I encounter some of the most delightfully furnished rooms I have ever been given the grace to see. Every room is out-fitted with air conditioning, beautiful panel ceiling fans, en-suite bathrooms, walk in wardrobes and flat screen TV’s. Every room is unique in its design and layout, the décor has a very English Baroque feel to it with heavy drapery and ornate rugs co-existing alongside beautifully made mahogany and oak pieces. You almost begin to feel as though you are residing in an old castle by the seaside. However, there are distinctive touches which highlight the nature of its tropical location. The two-storey villa hones in on an old Bajan Plantation element that one cannot help but feel comfortable in; the upper level houses very tastefully designed bedrooms, all with arresting views of the manicured grounds. The “Bajan Suite” or Master Suite, has its own private terrace overlooking the stunning garden and swimming pool below. It is elegant and private with a beautiful 4 poster king size bed alongside gorgeous mahogany armoires and vanities, giving it that special old world Caribbean charm. The Ocean Suite and Monkey Suites are equipped with two twin beds fitted in crisp white linens and corresponding décor to match the themes suggested in the names, such as a monkey lamp and wall art, tropical fish dresser and light fixtures all with little jungle animal accents. These youthful artistic touches make these suites ideal for families with young children.

The suites on the lower level provide the very same luxurious furnishings with light crisp fabrics juxtaposed with heavy antique accents, providing a grand yet understated elegance. The Garden Suite is the only room which allows full access to the exquisite lawns and garden directly from the room itself, with beautiful doors opening onto the expansive poolside terrace. The open spaces and airy, feel is a compliment to this exceptional villa, as one wanders from room to room engaged in awe at the beautiful art adorning the walls. Every room has something beautiful to offer.

Luxurious décor aside, Aliseo is much more than just a pretty face. The staff here are dedicated to making your stay as comfortable and carefree as possible. A holiday at Aliseo can start with a VIP meet and greet at the airport where guests are whisked through immigration queues and escorted to air conditioned luxury vehicles that await to take guests to the villa, an elegant start to what would be a very stylish vacation. Apart from the delightful butler, Aliseo offers guests the services of a housekeeper, laundress and a top rated chef, who can prepare an intimate breakfast or a sumptuous feast for 18, a relaxed lunch by the pool, or a more formal 3 course dinner if required; your wish is his command and he caters to the individual needs of each client. All guests also have access through Sandy Lane to the beach facility where they are provided with sun beds and umbrellas. Guests are also entitled to use the hotel’s award winning golf course, restaurants and spa by reservation. The butler can also arrange for cocktail evenings or afternoon canapés for some in-house entertainment, or even perhaps a wedding or two….and I hear through the grapevine that his rum punch is a force to be reckoned with!

Aliseo is the perfect venue for a wedding reception, what an ideal place to start your journey together. The beautifully manicured grounds offer more than enough space and the tropical flora ensures an amazing backdrop for the exchanging of vows on that special day. Ginger lilies cascade down from a coral stone wall alongside banana and coconut palms, neem trees and a shocking violet bougainvillea, all coming together to form a botanical vista that could compete with the Garden of Eden. The focal point of the garden would have to be the elevated private gazebo; its lofty heights descend down to the pool and provide a wide vista of the arresting beauty of this luxurious property as well as breathtaking sea views.

Apart from the innate beauty of its surroundings, the interiors have some distractions of their own; the villa offers an entertainment room with a karaoke machine and jukebox and an adjacent smaller kitchen. The room opens up straight onto the terrace and garden, giving guests access to all areas of the villa from this central point, assuring an effortless flow of traffic for all. There is also a media room come cinema which could rival any major movie theatre. Box-office movie posters adorn the walls as well as a giant screen directly opposite a russet coloured plush leather couch of extreme degrees of comfort; I know because I gave it a go. You would not need to ever leave the walls of this villa, as it has got everything you need to guarantee a great vacation.

There is also a games room that appeals to a whole other palate of amusement entirely; kitted out with pool/casino table, table tennis board, and retro décor on the walls from the likes of the Rat Pack and artist Arthur Sarnoff.

For all those on vacation who want to stay in shape in the comfort of their own home, there is an in-house gym with treadmill and weight machines. One can clearly conclude that there is something for everyone here at Aliseo. Customized arrangements can be made with the villa staff or the West Coast Villas concierge service. Special wedding packages are available on request and West Coast Villas provides a 24 hour committed property management service.

Additional Information:

The Garden suite has access to a private patio which leads out to the swimming pool
features: Located in the Sandy Lane Estate
Access to new beach bar at Sandy Lane

name: Dolphin Beach House
description:
Dolphin Beach House Barbados Villa is an exceptional 6-bedroom luxury property located right on the beach on the West Coast of Barbados. This brand-new villa comes complete with spacious indoor and outdoor seating areas, a sleek and well-equipped kitchen, a patio area with a private courtyard swimming pool, expansive beach front covered and uncovered terraces, breathtaking sea views from the main living area and almost every room.

The pièce de résistance is without doubt the direct access to the beach.

Imagine waking up to the sunrise and watching the sunset, just a leap away from the sandy beach.

Unlike most beachfront villas, 3 of the ensuite and air-conditioned bedrooms all have direct sea views with private sea facing balconies. The luxury lifestyle comes complete with the latest designer furniture and smart home technology and entertainment systems allowing you to enjoy the ancient sights and sounds of the Caribbean whilst relaxing amongst cutting edge interiors and effortless modern conveniences.

From morning to night your every moment will be catered to via management and concierge as well as an experienced villa team including Butler, Chef, Assistant Chef, Housekeeper, Laundress and Security Guard.

Sit back and relax in the comfort of this modern and impeccable villa whilst enjoying the best of beach front experiences from island style breakfasts and freshly brewed coffee as the island wakes to expertly made canapés and cocktails at sunset, followed by unforgettable fine dining under the stars.

name: Royal Westmoreland, Palm Ridge, Lelant
description:
Lelant is a stunning, contemporary villa located adjacent to the 16th fairway of the Royal Westmoreland Golf Resort in Barbados. Located on a ridge that benefits from the breeze and expansive views of the Caribbean Sea, this luxury holiday villa is perfect for your golf vacation and features 4 tastefully decorated bedrooms, all air-conditioned and with en suite bathrooms.

The spacious living rooms are well-decorated in neutral colours and open onto the expansive terrace.

The modern kitchen is any chef’s delight and opens directly onto a covered terrace for al fresco dining.

There is also a large fully air-conditioned media/games room with Sky TV and lots of books, puzzles and games for our guests to enjoy.

The first floor of Lelant is the exclusive preserve of the luxurious master bedroom, complete with a stunning en-suite bathroom and dressing area.

Both the bedroom and bathroom open onto the covered balcony where guests can relax and watch the action on the fairway, or just enjoy the views of the Caribbean Sea.

All holiday guests at Lelant also benefit from the exclusive Royal Westmoreland Beach Club located five minutes away at the enchanting Mullins Bay. Effortlessly trade your pool and deck for the soft sands and blue waters of Mullins Beach- a favorite for many Barbados visitors. Choose to snorkel or swim with vibrant tropical fish and turtles or relax in the warm Barbados sun. Services of the Beach Club include free shuttle service to Mullins Beach and Bell Captain beach service.

name: Sandy Lane, Amberley House
description:
Amberley House is an exquisite luxury property situated amongst impeccably maintained grounds in the prestigious Sandy Lane Estate.

Comfort, luxury and a modern flair come together to create one of the most desirable rental properties on the estate. Both house and cottage are beautifully decorated to create a vibrant living experience, synonymous with that of the Caribbean. Four of the six luxurious bedrooms are located in the main house, while the remaining two are conveniently located in the fully detached cottage.

Amberley House boasts a large covered terrace, wooden decking, a large pool and a heated Jacuzzi which makes it absolutely ideal for entertaining and relaxation. With its alluring décor, every modern convenience, delightful provisions for outdoor living, and beach access to the Sandy Lane Beach, Amberley House leaves nothing to be desired.

Amberley Lodge is a two-storey cottage featuring 1,200 sq ft of living space, inclusive two bedrooms and two full bathrooms with showers.  The Lodge has coral finishes both inside and out, with beautiful marble floor tiling.  The large covered terrace and stunning deck with Jacuzzi pool offer ample outdoor living space surrounded by mature gardens with Mahogany trees. The Lodge enjoys both peace and privacy with its own entrance with electric gate and parking for two vehicles.

Additional Information:

Closest beach: Sandy Lane

All bedrooms have air conditioning and ceilings fans

Swimming pool depth: Deep end 6ft; Shallow end 4ft

Television in media room

Safe in the Master Bedroom

Telephones available in kitchen, dining area, master bedroom and second bedroom

Beach Bar at Sandy Lane

The Bar serves drinks, (alcoholic and non-alcoholic) as well as an assortment of sandwiches, salads, fruits and ice cream. The opening hours are from 11.00am until 6.00pm daily. The Bar is for the use of members and guests only. We hope that you and your guests will make use of this facility.

name: Sandy Lane, Rose of Sharon
description:
Immerse yourself in the epitome of luxury at Rose of Sharon, a stunning six-bedroom villa perched atop the prestigious Sandy Lane Estate. This exquisite retreat offers an unforgettable escape for large groups of friends or families seeking an unparalleled vacation experience in the heart of Barbados.

Unwind in the villa's two beautifully appointed buildings: the main house boasting four ensuite bedrooms and the guest cottage providing an additional two ensuite bedrooms. Each room is a haven of tranquility, adorned with elegant furnishings and bathed in natural light, ensuring a restful retreat after a day of exploring the island's treasures.

Step outside into a tropical paradise: lush gardens envelop the property, leading to an expansive open-air deck overlooking a serene natural gully. A large swimming pool beckons with its refreshing waters, while the spacious sun deck provides an idyllic spot for sunbathing and relaxation.

Indulge in a world of pampering and convenience: A full complement of staff caters to your every need, ensuring a seamless and stress-free stay. Stay fit in the on-site fitness room, or retreat to the private office for uninterrupted work or study.

Unwind in exclusivity at the Sandy Lane Property Owners Beach Club: Enjoy complimentary beach loungers and umbrellas as you soak up the sun on one of the most exclusive beach facilities on the island. Sip on a refreshing rum punch as you gaze out at the mesmerizing Caribbean Sea, watching the stars emerge as dusk descends.

Rose of Sharon is more than just a villa; it's an embodiment of luxury, tranquility, and unforgettable memories.
amenities: Beach cabana on Sandy Lane Beach
features: Sandy Lane Property Owners Beach Access

name: Sandy Lane, Halle Rose
description:
Welcome to Halle Rose, a true gem nestled within the prestigious Sandy Lane Estate, offering an unparalleled experience for groups and families seeking an unforgettable getaway in the heart of Barbados. This exquisite six-bedroom villa is strategically positioned on West Ridge Road, adjacent to the 7th tee of the renowned Sandy Lane Old Nine golf course.

Halle Rose presents an idyllic retreat set amidst a sprawling 2 ½ acre tropical oasis adorned with meticulously manicured gardens. The expansive pool deck provides a breathtaking panorama of the Sandy Lane Old Nine golf course and the glistening Caribbean Sea beyond. Each of the six ensuite bedrooms is a sanctuary of luxury, ensuring utmost comfort and privacy for every guest.

Immerse yourself in the epitome of Barbadian hospitality with a dedicated and expertly trained staff at your service. From culinary delights showcasing the best of Bajan cuisine to ensuring your every need is met, our team is committed to providing a seamless and indulgent experience throughout your stay.

Beyond the confines of Halle Rose, a world of amenities and experiences unfolds. Guests enjoy exclusive access to the Sandy Lane Beach Club, where complimentary loungers and umbrellas invite you to unwind on the pristine sands. The vibrant Holetown area, just a leisurely descent down the hill, beckons with five-star dining, duty-free shopping, exhilarating water sports, and lively nightlife.

Whether you're planning a golf retreat or a group vacation, Halle Rose offers an unrivalled setting.
amenities: Beach cabana on Sandy Lane Beach
features: Sandy Lane Property Owners Beach Access

name: Martangie
description:
Nestled between two of our finest beaches……

This front-line classical villa has ample parking and a stunning entrance that leads to breathtaking sea views on the platinum coast- situated right on the nexus of Weston and Reeds Bay beaches on the West Coast of Barbados. This Barbados holiday rental is a home full of luxurious design flourishes. Access to the beach is via private gates placing you moments from the sand and sea. This spacious holiday rental is perfect for a family gathering or a holiday with friends.

Sublime views mean you never miss a moment of coastal bliss. Whether you are relaxing on sunbeds on the deck, settled on the comfy sofas on the covered yet open terrace, around the statement dining table or maybe at your private bar having a tipple with your barbecue sizzling away you can see and hear the Caribbean Sea. Two bedrooms also have private balconies with stunning views. A west-facing property means you will never miss the sunset and may even catch a glimpse of the infamous green flash.

A separate deck with sunbeds aligns with a waterfall pool for those moments you wish to submerge in clear water.

The outside living is complimented by irresistible outdoor dining on the spacious seaside patio, two spacious indoor open plan areas, one boasting an 85-inch TV with international channels, allowing you to sink into the cosy sofas and unwind, surrounded by fun Caribbean-themed original artwork. Sonos music systems compliment the space.

Four delightful, air-conditioned bedrooms, with ceiling fans, ensure sweet dreams all around. Equipped with soft lightweight duvets, quality linens and towels there is a luxurious feel. Each bedroom has a dedicated security safe for valuables and a hairdryer.

The attractive master bedroom features a private balcony with lounge area, super king size bed, sofa bed - suitable for up to two children, and a TV with international channels, ensuring your convenience.

The well-equipped kitchen, complete with a Nespresso machine, is available to you - or you can be looked after by your cook, supported by a housekeeper and laundress.

The home offers a unique Barbados vacation experience for family and friends for relaxing, lazy breakfasts, long lunches or dinners or as a base for exploring all the island has to offer. Fabulous memories will be made!

Please note:  The beach experiences seasonal fluctuations in its accessibility.

name: Sundeck House
Sandy Lane, Sandalwood House
description:
Discover Luxury and Tranquility at Sandalwood House, Sandy Lane, Barbados

Welcome to Sandalwood House, a luxurious vacation rental home nestled in the heart of the prestigious Sandy Lane Estate on Barbados' West Coast. Surrounded by over an acre of beautifully landscaped tropical gardens filled with towering palm trees and vibrant flora, this villa in Sandy Lane offers an inviting and tranquil retreat for those seeking the ultimate Barbados holiday experience.

From the moment you step onto the open-air terrace, you’ll be captivated by the breathtaking views of the lush gardens, sparkling pool, and serene Jacuzzi. This space is designed for relaxation, whether you're basking in the sun by the pool, enjoying a quiet afternoon tea in the charming Spanish-style gazebo, or taking in the picturesque scene of the nearby 3rd tee of the Old Nine Sandy Lane Golf Course. A private garden gate allows easy access for peaceful morning walks or jogs, making this Sandy Lane villa even more special.

Inside, the villa continues to impress with its spacious and comfortable living area, perfect for unwinding with family and friends. Equipped with UK TV channels and Bluetooth speakers, you’ll feel right at home while staying connected to your favorite shows and music. The main house features four beautifully appointed, air-conditioned bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom, ensuring a restful stay for all guests. For added convenience, there’s also a fifth bathroom on the ground floor, ideal for freshening up after a dip in the pool.

For those seeking extra privacy, Sandalwood House offers a charming self-contained cottage. This cozy retreat includes two ensuite bedrooms, a comfortable living area with a flat-screen TV, and a fully equipped kitchen. The cottage also boasts its own plunge pool, providing a perfect spot to unwind with a glass of wine as the sun sets.

One of the true highlights of staying at Sandalwood House is the exclusive access to the Sandy Lane Property Owners Beach Club. Here, you can enjoy sun loungers, umbrellas, and beachside food and drink services on the world-renowned Sandy Lane Beach, just a short drive away. This beachfront access makes it the ideal place to spend your days soaking up the sun and embracing the beauty of the Caribbean.

To complete your experience, Sandalwood House comes with a dedicated team of staff, including our Butler/Head Housekeeper, an additional Housekeeper and our Cook who has been making delicious meals there for 20 years.  The beautiful grounds are cared for by our full time Gardener, and for your added comfort, we have Night Security Guard. Their attentive service ensures that your every need is taken care of, allowing you to fully relax and enjoy your Barbados vacation.  Just read the reviews left by our previous, happy guests then decide your dates and give us a call!

Whether you’re planning a family vacation in Barbados, a romantic escape, or a peaceful retreat with friends, Sandalwood House offers the perfect blend of luxury, privacy, and island charm. With its prime location in Sandy Lane, this villa is the perfect choice for those seeking an unforgettable holiday rental on the West Coast of Barbados.

Start planning your dream Barbados vacation at Sandalwood House. Your tropical escape to Sandy Lane awaits!
amenities: Beach cabana on Sandy Lane Beach
features: Sandy Lane Property Owners Beach Access

name: Nirvana
description:
Experience all that contemporary luxury has to offer at Nirvana, a modern beachfront villa similar to Mirador, but with a fifth bedroom.

The ground floor living areas are spacious with a large family room featuring comfortable sofas, a 65-inch flat screen TV and guest bedroom. The best in-house chef prepared cuisine can be enjoyed in a formal setting within the upscale air conditioned interiors, or around the alfresco dining table which can seat up to 12 guests.

Foodies marvel at the delicacies created in the well equipped kitchen, which includes bar stools for easy breakfast meals. Both dining and family rooms open to face the wide covered terrace and then onto the outstanding outdoor areas with informal dining spaces, sun-loungers, enticing swimming pool and direct access to the beach. Retractable awnings or large sun umbrellas also offer plenty of shade.

Upstairs, the master bedroom and 3 other bedrooms can be found. With access to terraces, en-suite bathrooms and lavish finishes, there are only good views at this property. Nirvana’s rooftop floor has also been transformed into a unique sunset bar with plenty of seating, giving elevated sea and beach views.

Lastly, with smart home technology incorporated throughout the villa, guests feel connected no matter which space they’re in.
features: Espresso coffee machine (ground beans) + Coffee percolator

name: Queens Fort, Honeycomb House
description:
Honeycomb House Barbados is a truly special villa in Barbados. It is a one of a kind property in a superb location to access Holetown and the beautiful West Coast Beach.

Located just minutes walk down a leafy beach path from the beach it is in an ideal spot. Walk south at the end of the path to Colony Club and Coral Reef which are minutes' walk away. Walk north at the end of the beach path to head towards Glitter Bay and Lone Star.

This serene 5-bedroom villa in Queens Fort, has been a passion project for one of Barbados' most well-known designers, Sophie Domenge. It has only recently been completed and is new to the rental market.

Honeycomb House rents with the services of a housekeeper and a cook. A butler can be arranged at additional cost upon request.    The villa has its own private swimming pool, fire pit, covered BBQ dining area and yoga/exercise studio.

This stunning villa has been re-imagined and carefully redesigned. It has been completely refurbished and furnished.  It offers the very best in finishes and workmanship. The designer worked alongside local artisans to design and install completely bespoke interiors. There are perfectly sized furnishings to the finest decorations. Every special item has been thoughtfully placed to enhance the experience of home.

Honeycomb House is designed as a circle with entertainment and enjoyment spaces at its 'honeycomb' heart. The main home stretches alongside the pool deck . This allows the rooms to benefit from beautiful views and ample natural light.

Stand out features include 4 beautiful en-suite bedrooms. 2 of these are in the main house and the other 2 are in the separate cottage. All with King Beds. It would be difficult to say which is the master bedroom because all 4 are of an equal standard. There is also a playfully decorated kids' bedroom in the main house with large 'floating' bunk beds ( beds 90cms). Rain showers open to the sky and feature delicate live orchids.

There is a "hidden" office and television lounge spaces. A welcome lounge is decorated in soft sand tones. This flows onto the dining terrace.

The home's main kitchen features integrated stainless steel appliances. There are carefully planned storage and work spaces. This is complemented by a lounge with bar and barbeque area shaded by the poolside gazebo.

The 'exercise/yoga' studio sits across the pool with durable wood toned floors. Standing mirrors and large framed glass windows overlook the tropical gardens.

In the guest cottage are 2 double en suite bedrooms, each with a dedicated private terrace. These flank a quaint country style kitchen. This is the perfect spot for guests to enjoy their own space.

All bedrooms and the main living room have air conditioning and ceiling fans.

The villa is located in the much sought after and unique Queens Fort community. It is on the island's famous west coast just a 3 minute walk from the beach. Holetown with all its amenities is close by. Here you will find supermarkets, duty free shopping, cinemas and a medical centre.

The location encourages early morning and "any time" ocean swims. The beach is accessed down a leafy beach path close by.     The beach access opens to a gorgeous stretch of beach. This has recently been enhanced and protected and invites long strolls along the ocean's edge.

As the sun sets, the thoughtful design beckons guests to return to Honeycomb House. Relax around the carefully crafted fire pit in the private garden, sparkling with soft fairy lights. Living here is like living in a private oasis. Come through the gates and relax in peace and tranquility.

Honeycomb House Barbados may be rented with (or without) the beautiful 5 bedroom  Villa Melissa   which is right next door.

name: Java Bay
description:
Java Bay is a 5,000 sq. ft. Balinese villa, designed by London architect, Harper Downie. It is situated on a ¾ acre ridge plot (30,000 sq. ft.) within the gated community of Calijanda, adjoining Royal Westmoreland and Sugar Hill.

The property overlooks the stunning West coast of Barbados, with 180-degree views and is within a 5-minute drive of Holetown with its local restaurants, shops and beaches. The villa has an open plan layout and is furnished in an elegant Indonesian style, which is complimented by Portuguese limestone and granite, with handmade carvings from Bali. The spacious and versatile design can accommodate 8/9 people in great comfort and total privacy.

The property is approached through electric gates leading onto a private drive. The accommodation is arranged over 2 floors and comprises the following:

Ground Floor – limestone entrance hall, large formal dining hall which seats 10, media area, sitting room, fully fitted kitchen and breakfast area which leads onto a large pool deck, utility room, 15m infinity edge pool and a tree house which seats 8 for dining and seating. Master bedroom with en suite bathroom and private courtyard with day bed and outside spa bathing, 2nd king size bedroom with private courtyard garden and outdoor shower, single bedroom and 2 shower rooms.

Fi r st Floor – accessed by a mahogany and glass staircase leading onto a bridge, 1 double bedroom and 1 twin bedroom both with en suite bathrooms and ocean views.

Please Note: Maximum Occupancy  -  8 Guests .

name: Portobello Villa
description:
Portobello Villa is almost too exquisite for words. This 5-bedroom villa has everything needed for an epic vacation on Barbados’ West Coast, including jaw dropping ocean views. Each of the ensuite bedrooms has unobstructed sea views. Accommodating up to 9 guests comfortably, no one will miss out on enjoying that Caribbean blue. Of course, it’s not just for admiring.

There are beautifully clear waters directly in front of the villa for swimming, that are easily accessed via steps from the terrace. The sea-facing terrace has sun loungers for sunbaking, reading or simply gazing at the Caribbean. And the terrace leads to a unique infinity edge pool, just for Portobello Villa guests. There’s a table tennis table and outdoor exercise area for those who like to stay active on holiday. Contemporary finishes and clean lines only enhance the spaciousness of the fully air-conditioned property. Dine under the sun or stars in the alfresco dining area.

The fully equipped bar makes it easy to sip a sundowner in the alfresco lounge while watching the sunset. Play a game of chess on the breezy, shady terrace, or relax on the day bed which boasts a stunning view of Batts Rock Bay. It may be difficult to leave your oasis but taking a stroll to the beachfront restaurant of La Cabane to dine is also recommended.

Located at Batts Rock Bay, Portobello Villa is just a short drive away from Holetown’s nightlife, as well as many restaurants offering the catch of the day. A holiday would not be complete without pampering. Enjoy the services of a cook and housekeeper, year-round. A babysitter and security guard may also be requested.
features: Short Drive to Amenities and Nightlife in Holetown

name: Atelier House
description:
Sitting on a ridge above the west coast of Barbados with dramatic views out to the ocean, Atelier House is a stunning Caribbean retreat. The design was conceptualised in close collaboration with the interior architect/owner, who has completed projects for discerning homeowners in London, France, Italy, and Kenya.

The dramatic double-height living space maximizes the stunning views which extend beyond the outdoor terraces and pool across a mahogany tree-filled gully to the Caribbean Sea. In addition to the ground-level terraces and 32 x 27 ft. pool there is a large roof terrace and mezzanine-level study offering stunning views of the West Coast. The villa is surrounded by a half-acre of gardens featuring indigenous palms, lilies, bougainvillea, and many flowering shrubs.

Atelier House has 4 spacious bedrooms. The upstairs master suite has a glazed balcony with views over the sea and a covered outdoor terrace for relaxing; the ensuite bathroom features separate bath and shower facilities. The 3 guest bedrooms are all located on the ground floor. The ensuite guest bedroom features an enclosed outdoor shower, while the 2 additional guest bedrooms share a bathroom.

  Note: Weddings and small events are allowed on a request basis at an additional cost with a maximun of 75 Guests.
features: Located on West Coast, near all amenities
Two kitchens; one in the pavilion; the other at the rear of the villa

name: Smugglers Cove 5
description:
This creatively and vibrantly designed luxurious apartment is located on one of the most desirable beaches on island, where safe swimming, snorkelling and beach service awaits guests. The apartment has the perfect open plan layout ideal for entertaining, dining and lounging with friends and family.

Smugglers Cove 5, is a luxury 4 bedroom, beach front apartment. It is ideally positioned, this luxury development will afford guests effortless walks to what is arguably the best beach in Barbados.

Its position and layout make it absolutely ideal for outdoor dining.

Synonymous with the architecture and aesthetic of the entire development- Smugglers Cove 5 is immaculately designed. Classic Caribbean Architecture in conjunction with bold dramatic pieces and every modern convenience provides the best of both worlds for those looking for the perfect luxurious Caribbean Retreat.  

Additional Information:

ADSL speed: Max 64 - 1 M

Communal lap swimming pool

Direct beach access from apartment

Two single beds can be used as a King bed or used separately
features: Designed with outdoor living in mind
Safe swimming directly in front of the building
Beach bar within a short walk along the beach
Fine dining restaurant within a short walk along beach
Great for sunset or early morning walks along the beach

name: Royal Westmoreland, Sienna
description:
Sienna is an elegant, modern villa in the peaceful, secure, gated community of Coconut Grove, Royal Westmoreland on the premium West Coast of Barbados.This 3-bedroom, luxurious villa has fabulous views of the 10th fairway and the Caribbean Sea beyond. It is a delightful, private retreat only minutes away from the best restaurants, golf, polo, tropical sun-kissed beaches and designer shopping at The Lime Grove Lifestyle Center in Holetown or Cave Shepherd in Sunset Crest. Set amongst tropical gardens, the view from the splendid Great Room out over the covered pool deck and the pristine sandy bunkers of the Robert Rent Jones golf course, will quite simply take your breath away. Guests of this property can also enjoy access to all resort conveniences, including club house, gym, tennis courts, golf, and beach facilities at the popular Mullins Beach.

The interior of this fashionable villa will impress the most discerning of guests. There are travertine marble floors throughout, huge panoramic windows and indoor and outdoor terraces. Of the 3 en suite bedrooms, one is particularly suited to children.

For those who love to cook (and those who like to eat!), there is a fully equipped and professional grade kitchen. There are dining areas inside and outside for alfresco eating – making the most of the temperate climate. The outdoor spaces are exceptional, with terraces, BBQ, and chill-out area perfect for sunbathing, reading, or enjoying a cocktail, as well as the private swimming pool.

For indoor relaxation there is a media room with a 65′ plasma screen internet TV – with BBC, SKY SPORTS, NETFLIX, and HULU for example.

Dora, the treasured housekeeper, is on hand to ensure that you feel welcome and indulged during your stay and a private villa cook can be hired to prepare a perfect romantic meal for two or an intimate dinner party with friends.

Sienna is the ideal luxury rental villa for a romantic escape, a family holiday, or a group of friends - it will not disappoint.

Contact Barbados Sotheby’s Realty to check availability at this Royal Westmoreland location and secure your little piece of Paradise in Barbados.

Full Membership :

The member, spouse/partner and any children have full access to all the facilities (Sanctuary gym, pools, jacuzzi, tennis courts, golf course, driving range and Mullins Beach Club).

Villa guests register for houseguest cards which give them access to the facilities.

With reference to golf for guests residing in the villa, the unaccompanied Full Member’s Guest or the Twilight green fees would be applicable (or if accompanied by the member, the Member Guest fee).

name: Royal Westmoreland, Mango Walk
description:
Mango Walk is a luxurious and imposing villa, situated on the West Coast of Barbados in the prestigious Royal Westmoreland Golf Resort. Electric gates invite you to a long, sweeping driveway, lined with mature gardens and Imperial Palms, leading to an Italian fountain and several cascading water features. Enter this impressive villa via French floor to ceiling glass doors and enjoy the stunning indoor/outdoor living concept central courtyard, from where this exceptional property can be explored.

Traditional features blend tastefully with modern clear glass windows and doors along with quality contemporary style furniture. The newly upgraded fully equipped kitchen with bar stools serves the elegant air-conditioned internal dining room, which opens up onto the beautiful and spacious pool deck and BBQ areas, which surround a stunning infinity pool, one of the largest on Royal Westmoreland. A substantial modern and yet comfortable living room with TV also takes you onto the large pool deck with sun loungers and umbrellas.

The oversized pool, with one of a kind dolphin mosaic feature, helps set the scene for this luxurious tropical escape. The entry level floor also includes 3 large bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, each with private outdoor terrace.

The lower level includes an additional expansive guest apartment with its own entrance, large bedroom, open plan living area, ensuite bathroom and private dressing room.

A separate, well appointed, stylish and private one bedroom cottage, with its own secluded terrace, is located in the tropical gardens, which provides an air of tranquility. All bedrooms are fitted with smart TV's with over six hundred channels including US & UK programs.

The epitome of Caribbean luxury, the entire top floor accommodates an amazing and very private master bedroom suite with ensuite bathroom, walk in wardrobes and an oversized terrace providing superb sea and luscious tropical garden views. In addition to the internal stairs, this impressive balcony and master bedroom suite can also be accessed via an external staircase leading from the magnificent pool and decking.

Guests also have the option of enjoying additional and separate amenities on the lower level, accessed either externally or from the lounge, these include a large cinema room with a hundred-inch TV, well equipped gym and an adjacent games room with pool table, air hockey, table tennis, darts, and table football. There is also a bar/relaxation area situated on this level.

From the pool deck guests can take steps down to the gazebo surrounded by lush gardens, a perfect spot for late night drinks or just to relax with a book whilst enjoying the relaxing sounds of the Caribbean.

This impeccable and well equipped six-bedroom holiday villa guarantees memorable holidays for large groups, families with children or families traveling together and can accommodate up to 12 adults. It is also ideal for those individuals desiring a private retreat.

All rentals include housekeeping, laundress, chef/cook, property management, concierge and a full-time gardener/handy man, and 24 hour resort security.

Whilst fully updated and upgraded with a modern contemporary theme throughout, the villa is located in one of the few original resort home positions, ensuring privacy. Mango Walk is also therefore within a few minutes’ walk or golf buggy drive to the club house with bar/restaurant and the member’s sanctuary with a large pool, full gym and informal bar/restaurant. Other amenities include the famous championship 18-hole golf course, tennis, pickle ball and, of course, the beach club at Mullins with beach chairs and parasols and the new Larry Roger’s beach bar and restaurant.

Mango Walk – stroll through paradise…..
features: On Robert Trent Jr Golf Course
State of the Art Alarm System
En Suite Bedrooms with Smart Televisions

name: Queens Fort, Villa Melissa
description:
Villa Melissa a perfect family villa in Barbados! It offers 5 ensuite bedrooms, spread over the main house and a self-contained cottage, all air-conditioned and with ceiling fans - an ideal arrangement for two families or a group of friends.

There are 3 air-conditioned bedrooms in the main house (2 of the bedrooms and bathrooms each with floor length windows accessing the garden, have recently been renovated) and both bedrooms have large walk-in showers and twin vanities. The master bedroom also has floor length windows on 2 sides, so it overlooks the pool and the garden.

A further 2 double air-conditioned ensuite bedrooms are in the delightful, self-contained cottage, constructed of original coral stone. There are fossils on its walls and the bedrooms are large and furnished in calming cream and taupe. The master bedroom with ensuite bathroom is particularly romantic with a delightful four-poster bed - often the first choice of accommodation for honeymooners. While the second bedroom can be arranged as a double or with twin beds. There is also a kitchen and 2 private terraces. There is a combination of King, Queen, and twin beds to suit most requirements.

There is an air-conditioned media room in the main house. This is equipped with a 60-inch flat screen smart tv and DVD player. The TV package includes Netflix and sports from the UK, USA and Canada plus the latest movies and live TV from popular destinations for guests' enjoyment. There is also a writing desk in this room for those wanting to tuck themselves away to work. A cloakroom is also located next to the media room.

An open modern kitchen opens right out into the garden. It is a cook's delight with 2 fridge freezers, 2 ovens, microwave, dishwasher, wine fridge, butler's pantry and much more. Of course, you don't have to do the cooking! Eurice the cook is there to look after you and of course the restaurants and bars in Barbados offer a wide range of wonderful, tasty cuisine in seafront settings.

The large saltwater swimming pool sits in the middle of picturesque and spacious gardens which are beautifully landscaped. The pool is divided into two areas by stepping-stones. These create a 3 feet shallow end which is ideal for children and there is ample comfortable seating close by so children may be watched from the water's edge. On the other side of the stepping-stones is a deeper swimming area which is 4' x 6” deep throughout; Ideal for those who like to swim lengths.

One of the most popular features of Villa Melissa is the thatched tiki bar fondly known as 'Chubs One Love Bar.' This is located next to the pool and from here you may sit in the shade and enjoy your favourite refreshment. It tends to be the focal point of the garden where guests sit and play scrabble, backgammon, and other games. A wonderful place to enjoy an evening cocktail before dinner. There is a choice of dining areas including the round coral stone table on the covered terrace. There is also an outdoor wooden rectangular table where you can dine under the stars by the pool. The bar has Sonos so bring your own music to enjoy.

Enjoy beach life yet escape to the oasis of the house and garden which is home to wonderful bird life. If you're lucky you will see green monkeys scampering across the garden walls.

Villa Melissa is located on the popular West Coast in the parish of St. James, a short drive from all the amenities, shops, restaurants, and bars of Holetown and on a private road that leads to the beach path, just a 3-minute stroll down a dreamy, leafy, path to the beach. If you take a stroll on the beach, you will find many luxury hotel resorts just a short walk, such as Coral Reef Club, Colony Club, Royal Pavilion and Glitter Bay.

Villa Melissa has been listed as one of the top 30 villas in the Caribbean and is rented with a cook, housekeeper/laundress and Ian, the general assistant. Ian will prepare your drinks at the bar and serve your meals.

For those parties needing more than 5 bedrooms Villa Melissa can be rented with Honeycomb H ouse the beautiful 5-bedroom house next door (if) available.
features: Pool has Enchanting Light Show at Night

name: Royal Westmoreland, Fig Tree House and Cottage
features: Located in Royal Westmoreland Luxury Resort
Infinity Swimming Pool with Poolside Shower Room

name: Weston House
description:
Weston House is nestled on a secluded beachfront lot in St. James on the West Coast of Barbados, with parking for several cars behind the electric security gates. The pool deck and gazebo are the perfect place to while away an afternoon in the sun, enjoying a drink or reading a good book, all within earshot of the gentle rolling waves of the Caribbean Sea. Lunch and dinner can be served on the terrace, with a view of the tropical garden and beach beyond.

The villa has five air-conditioned guest rooms, all with Ensuite bathrooms. Four of these are in the main house with the fifth bedroom set in a lovely self-contained apartment which leads onto the pool deck, the perfect setting for a morning cup of tea and for watching children playing in the pool. The master bedroom and patio of the main house offer gorgeous panoramic ocean views and are well positioned to enjoy the vibrant daily sunsets.

Alongside the beautiful location and the luxurious surroundings, what makes a holiday at Weston House is our terrific team. Our team will treat your palate to both local and international cuisine, and their local knowledge is invaluable. No task or request is too much, whether it is a private yacht charter or big game fishing to the local bus service, they will help you find it.

You really will have the best vacation in your home away from home!

name: Royal Westmoreland, Royal Palm Villa 4
description:
Royal Palm Villa 4 is part of a development of beautiful, four-bedroom, detached luxury villas each with a large private swimming pool and garden, located just behind the 17th tee.

The property boasts 4 spacious bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom and has two master suites, with one featuring a private study and view over the pool and gardens, and the other with a walk out veranda and covered sitting area. The main living space features a large open plan design with vaulted timber tray ceiling, and floor to ceiling glass doors for the full expanse of the entrance to the covered veranda and pool.

The Miele designed open plan kitchen has a generous centre island that is great for the family social gathering or to prep for the BBQ pool side. The most impressive feature of this room is the wide-open view out onto the pool and pool deck area. Dining is outside under the covered veranda.

The infinity pool measures 12ft by 41ft and the “sun lounger pool” where two sun beds sit comfortably in a 9” pool of refreshing water. The pool deck area is also huge with space for an additional outdoor living area, with space for numerous sun loungers and a dining table. This area is partially covered. This property type measures an impressive total of 2,693 sq ft covered space and 985 sq ft uncovered space.

name: Coral Cove 14, Crowsnest
description:
Crowsnest – Coral Cove 14 is a spacious 3,400 square foot Barbados beachfront penthouse for holiday rental. This luxury villa commands the southern corner of the outstanding beachfront condominium building known as Coral Cove. The property is ideally located on the exclusive Payne Bay Beach within a short walk of Sandy Lane Hotel and One Sandy Lane. There are also a wide selection of amenities and restaurants just a few minutes’ drive away.

Crowsnest – Coral Cove 14 ticks all the boxes required for that perfect Barbados holiday home. Expertly furnished to well above market standards, the marble floors and coral rendered feature walls blend effortlessly with the modern finish and layout. Terrace doors open onto a wide wrap-around terrace that boasts unobstructed views of the Caribbean Sea. Guests can also enjoy a view of the perfect crescent beach of Paynes Bay by day or during the spectacular evening sunsets. The 3 spacious bedrooms are well-appointed with walk-in wardrobes, en-suite bathrooms and air conditioning. In addition, the master bedroom has its own private sea-facing terrace from which views of the crisp morning horizon can be enjoyed.

Being a corner penthouse unit, bedrooms 2 and 3 also benefit from having windows to the south. This window position adds a feeling of light and space to the already large bedroom dimensions. Bathrooms and the kitchen offer a modern cutting-edge design which is very much in demand in today’s market. Communally the property includes sliding electric gates manned by 24hr security, security cameras, assigned covered parking and beach security access. Each morning the beach is prepared for any rental guests in house where luxury sun loungers and umbrellas await. A housekeeper/cook works 6 days a week who also prepares breakfast and light lunches.

name: Glitter Bay 201, Eternity
description:
Glitter Bay 201, also known as ‘Eternity', has an enviable position right on the beach, offering amazing views of the idyllic coastline and turquoise Caribbean Sea.

The white sands and lush tropical gardens provide an incredible backdrop for this island penthouse retreat, which feels worlds away from the modern pace of life. The owners have spared no expense; the property has been lovingly maintained and upgraded to create one of the most attractive holiday homes on the West Coast.

A relaxing teal and white colour scheme adds character to this space which feels modern and beach chic at the same time. With ample seating outdoors on the terrace, visitors can enjoy al fresco cocktails while looking out at the water and mature tropical gardens.

As part of the Glitter Bay Estate, guests at Eternity have access to a private entrance, ample parking, swimming pool, beach bar, full-time security and management services. 

Additional Information:

Access to tennis courts, on-site restaurant & gym

Towel policy: Beach towels are available for use during your stay. Register in the office and receive your towel tokens, these can be redeemed for towels from the Beach Butlers . 

Towels can be exchanged daily and the tokens should be returned at the end of your stay. Lost towels or tokens will be charged at BDS$50 per towel.
features: Close to amenities on the West Coast

name: Portico 1
description:
Portico...Where excellence is not an achievement but a way of life

Portico 1 is an impressive oceanfront property offering 3 bedrooms, 3.5  bathrooms within 3,500 sq. ft. of living space featuring cutting edge finishes, luxurious furnishings and outstanding amenities. The apartment features a 40 ft. wide private terrace with plunge pool and glass balustrade, providing unparalleled views of the ocean. Enjoy the private gym and sauna, 80 ft. lap pool.

Winner of 3 prestigious, 5-star International Property Awards for Best Architecture, Best Development and Best Apartment in the Caribbean. Portico is distinguished by its outstanding finishes, revolutionary design and modern take on island living. Located on the serene and picturesque Prospect Bay in St. James, Barbados. Portico stands as a true personification of sophistication and state-of-the-art living that is distinct from any other residential development on the island’s West Coast.

The development's extraordinary architecture makes way for a lifestyle that will be enjoyed by a select few; with just 2 units on each of the 5 floors, owners are sure to enjoy a level of privacy and exclusivity unparalleled on the island. The tropical modern style was conceptualized to merge the interior living space with the property’s stunning environs; glass balustrades and ample windows offer uninterrupted views of the stunning Caribbean Sea.

The remarkable lifestyle that Portico offers will undoubtedly surpass expectations, with an impressive array of amenities, 5-star concierge services and steadfast dedication to both personal and environmental well-being. The uniqueness of Portico extends beyond its architecture and indulgent lifestyle. Its facilities are nothing short of spectacular, ensuring residences the best that innovation has to offer.

The residences

Ten luxurious units featuring 3,500 sq. ft. of living and breathing space • 3 exceptional bedrooms with en suite bathrooms and spacious walk-in closets • master features double glass doors opening to private terraces and views of the Caribbean Sea • fully equipped open plan kitchens • spacious living areas luxuriously appointed with marble floors in an ivory coloured antique finish • terrace with uninterrupted glass fronted balustrade and frameless sliding glass doors • heated Jacuzzis • underground parking • 70 sq. ft. storage and wine facilities • separate staff-lunch area, including changing rooms, lockers, bathroom and shower facilities.

Penthouse apartments include; additional 1,500 sq. ft. private roof terrace with breathtaking 360 views, private pool, entertaining area and lush landscaping • garden apartments feature additional 1,500 sq. ft. of private gardens and sun terrace.

Architecture

Contemporary design • creative fusion of modern and traditional architecture with glass, marble and hand-crafted cedar finishes • striking atrium with 60° glass curtain wall, magnificent water feature, kinetic hanging sculpture, marble stairway • glass-front elevator overlooking the Caribbean Sea.

Location

Situated on a 15 ft. bluff, overlooking the Caribbean sea • located opposite one of the island’s best diving reefs featuring the Stavronika, a 365 ft. sunken wreck in 120 ft. of water • beautiful beach walk  • 10 minutes north of the vibrant capital Bridgetown • 10 minutes south of the chic Limegrove Lifestyle Centre and historic Holetown district • close to shopping, groceries and medical services • near to nightlife and world-class restaurants

Finishes

NEFF (Canada) kitchen • sanitary ware by Villeroy and Boch • Cambria quartz countertops • marble tiling throughout • handmade solid cedar door and window frames • cedar closets • glass mosaic tiling in pool areas • double-glazed tempered glass used throughout • Dornbracht • ‘Jason’ Hydrotherapy air and whirlpool combination tubs with chromatherapy lighting • integral air-conditioning systems • ambient cove lighting

Technology

Dedicated and secure GPX phone system with half mile range • wireless cat 5 Bluetooth Internet • 5.1 Surround Sound Theatre System • Audiophile quality sound system • sound and lighting control panels • light sensors

Amenities

Cybex fitness centre with panoramic sea views, audio-visual entertainment system and air-conditioning • luxurious changing rooms, showers and sauna • 85-ft heated infinity edge lap pool with tempered glass and mosaic tile finishes • sunbathing deck • private access gate to prospect beach

Lifestyle

Five-star concierge service available offering the ultimate in luxurious, care-free living • housekeeping services • private chefs and catering • chauffeurs • childcare and babysitting • excursion planning including island tours, tee times and sailing expeditions • tickets to cultural, social and sporting events • dining reservations • event planning • regional travel planning by air or sea

Security

24-hour security staff and dedicated security desk • multi-location passive infrared CCTV system with non-intrusive monitoring • keypad and swipe card security access • camera integrated intercom system for apartment entry • intrusion detection (entry and glass) • remote locking garage door system for vehicle access to underground car park • comprehensive smoke and fire detection • two elevators designed to function during emergencies on back-up system

Well-being

Structure and glass atrium built to withstand 130mph winds and missiles of category 3 • buildings are fully accessible by disabled persons including pool areas • sound-absorbing Proflex layer between floors • Quietpipe insulation on all piping to eliminate noise • 24-hour property management response service • dedicated water and power emergency supply • discreet garbage chutes • water softener systems for both kitchens and bathrooms

Eco-friendly innovation

The building design maximises use of natural light and cool breezes • vantage lighting control system and sensors • energy efficient bulbs used throughout development • tinted and double glazed windows to reduce heat and noise • Toshiba SMMS (variable refrigerant flow) air-conditioning system utilising 50% less energy per annum • heat insulators on the roof • solar panel heated pools • programmable water heaters • onsite wastewater treatment and underground rainwater collection facility for irrigation • glass and plastic recycling collection • considerable resources dedicated to preserving two, 80 year old oceanfront Mahogany trees • extensive landscaping.

Additional Information

Equipped with Apple TV

Closest beach: Batts Rock

name: Smugglers Cove 4
description:
Smugglers Cove 4 is a luxurious beach front apartment has an ideal layout for outdoor dining. The apartment is located in an exclusive development situated on one of the most desirable beaches on island and is centrally located near all amenities. To name a few - fine dining restaurants, medical facilities, tennis courts and much more.

Its position and layout make it absolutely ideal for outdoor dining.

Synonymous with the architecture and aesthetic of the entire development- Smugglers Cove 4 is immaculately designed. Classic Caribbean Architecture in conjunction with bold dramatic pieces and every modern convenience provides the best of both worlds for those looking for the perfect luxurious Caribbean Retreat.

Additional Information:

Communal lap swimming pool

Televisions in each bedroom

Direct beach access from the apartment

Security safe in Master bedroom and bedroom 3

Two single beds can be used jointly as a King bed or separately

Great for sunset or early morning walks along the beach

name: Schooner Bay 307, The Lookout
description:
The Lookout is a superb, two-storey apartment featuring three centrally air-conditioned bedrooms, each with luxurious en suite bathrooms and marble tiling throughout.

The Schooner Bay development has lovely, landscaped gardens, a communal swimming pool and direct access to a beautiful white sand beach. The secure gated community is located just a few minutes' walk from Speightstown, with an array of charming seaside restaurants, shops and amenities.  No Children .

Additional Information:

Guests have access to the three guest bedrooms and roof terrace equipped with BBQ

Gym hours: 7:00 am - 7:00 pm

Pool hours: 8:00 am - 7:00 pm

The communal gym includes:

A Multi Gym

Treadmill

Bike

Free weights

name: Sandy Cove 302, The Pearl
description:
The Pearl at Sandy Cove is an elegantly furnished three bedroom apartment nicely situated on the third floor of the well maintained and privately owned Sandy Cove residential development and boasts breath-taking views of the turquoise Caribbean Sea.

This 3,200 sq. ft. open plan apartment, is a hidden gem with its chic décor, exquisite finishes and stunning views.

Large bespoke wooden doors beckon you inside the opulent foyer with two tastefully furnished bedrooms well positioned to the right. The kitchen, living room, covered dining terrace and Master suite are situated to the left. The tray ceilings throughout the residence, beige marble floors, coral stone interiors and specially chosen accent pieces lend to the feel of luxury throughout. The apartment offers a stylish yet warm feel, welcoming guests to a lavish holiday beyond their imagination.

The attractive yet very functional kitchen features Miele appliances, a double door fridge, a microwave, an oven and dishwasher.

The living room is elegantly furnished with plush settees and complimentary Mother of Pearl accent pieces. There is a large flat screen TV equipped with both cable and Apple TV for those who tire of watching the stunning sunsets or unobstructed views of the sea.

The large covered terrace is outfitted with a dining table, a bar and wine chiller plus a private uncovered plunge pool ideal for basking in the sun. A private door on this terrace opens to a shared stairway that leads down to the gym, garden, communal pool and the turquoise sea and sandy beach.

The captivating views from The Pearl are second to none. Views of the Caribbean sea can be enjoyed from the kitchen, living room, covered terrace, plunge pool and Master suite. Imagine yourself sipping cocktails at sunset or simply enjoying a delicious meal with the bluest crystal clear water just beyond your balcony.

The ocean-facing Master suite boasts a King bed, TV, walk-through closet and en suite bathroom with a shower and a deep bathtub ideal for long leisurely baths. Bedroom 2 also has a King bed with TV and en suite bathroom with tub and shower.  The third bedroom has twin beds that can be made as a king, TV and en suite bathroom with shower only. 

The Pearl has ceiling fans and is air-conditioned throughout for comfort.

Offering privacy, seclusion and unparalleled island living, this development boasts a fantastic free form pool with bridge, beautiful deck for sunbathing and relaxing while reading a book. Guests of Sandy Cove have access to the private gym and sauna, secure parking, state-of-the-art communications network, 24/7 security and an on-site maintenance team. 

The development has direct access to two secluded beaches and also a mile long stretch of more public beach. The calm waters on the west coast are perfect for children and adults alike and allow snorkelers the opportunity to see an abundance of marine life up close. 

At night from the pool terrace one can enjoy the lights from the Cliff Restaurant right next door beaming through the water showcasing a unique array of marine life including stingrays and tarpon. A wide variety of water sports are available a short walk along the white sandy beach.
features: Miles of white beach to take a long walk
Stunning sea views from the spacious terrace
Impeccable beach - great for swimming & snorkeling

name: Radwood Beach House 1
Smugglers Cove 1
description:
This luxury apartment is immaculately designed offering classical Caribbean architecture harmonizing with modern conveniences, creating a luxurious Caribbean retreat.  A quaint outdoor terrace is perfectly situated adjacent to the beach where clear blue skies or starry nights can be enjoyed.

Smugglers Cove 1 is a luxury 3-bedroom, beachfront apartment, ideally positioned on the ground floor of this luxury development and will afford guests effortless walks to what is arguably, the best beach in Barbados.

Its position and layout make it absolutely, ideal for outdoor dining, as guests can relax and entertain under clear skies on the spacious lanai.

Synonymous with the architecture and aesthetic of the entire development, Smugglers 1 is immaculately designed. Classic Caribbean Architecture in conjunction with bold dramatic pieces and every modern convenience provides the best of both worlds for those looking for the perfect luxurious Caribbean Retreat.

name: Westmoreland Hills, Villa Nomade
description:
Offering panoramic sea views within this new luxury private gated community, Villa Nomade will become your family’s home away from home for many years to come. This beautiful villa consists of 4 bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, and a 5th bedroom used as an office with a pull-out sofa bed which has its own full bathroom.  Three of the bedrooms benefit from sea views and a balcony.

You will enjoy stunning views and afternoon sunsets while sipping on Bajan Rum Punch, lounging in your 30 ft. private pool, with the sun on your face, and the breezes at your back. The breathtaking, expansive deck area has 8 sun loungers, comfortable soft seating, and outdoor dining for up to 10 people with miraculous sea views that cannot be matched. The clever design provides shade in the dining and soft seating area leaving the loungers in the sun for topping up your tan.

The Full open plan lets you enjoy everyone’s company until it is time to retire for the night, to rest and rejuvenate for the following day.

Access to Onsite Communal Facilities

In addition to the villas private pool, guests have access to all onsite communal facilities which include a 70 ft. pool surrounded by sun loungers, outdoor shower, changing rooms, gym, yoga studio, and cafe.

9:00am - 6:00pm - Pool

6:00am - 8:00pm - Gym 

Access to Fairmont Beach Club

Guests will have access to the Fairmont Beach Club where you can enjoy the sun, sand, and the sea. The beach club has 32 chairs and 16 beach umbrellas in total for use, access to parking, restrooms/changing rooms, a terrace equipped with outdoor furniture adjoining the Water Sports area, and an onsite restaurant.

name: Smugglers Cove 2
description:
This expertly furnished luxury apartment is located within this low density Sandy Lane styled beachfront property that includes 24hr security, concierge and management. The property also includes shared tropical gardens and an inviting swimming pool. Private sunbeds and umbrellas are available on Paynes Bay Beach where an attentive beach service awaits.

The apartment benefits from a large covered terrace and dining area and the master bedroom and living and terrace areas spill out onto an exceptional uncovered patio area where one can sit and enjoy the luxury of this special spot on Paynes Bay Beach where swimming pool, manicured tropical gardens and the swept beach, sun beds, umbrellas and beach butler service awaits.

No. 2 Smugglers Cove includes 3 bedrooms all with their own en suite bathrooms and dressing areas as well as ceiling fans and integral air conditioning. The well equipped kitchen includes granite work surfaces and a large double sub zero fridge freezer.
features: Enjoy early morning walks on beach
Designed with outdoor living in mind
Safe swimming on Paynes Bay beach
The only 3 bedroom apartment for sale
Beach bar & restaurants within a short walk along the beach

name: Radwood Beach House 2
description:
This impeccable beachfront villa offers incredible views and direct access to one of the most secluded and serene beaches on the West Coast where white sands, swimming and snorkeling awaits.

The property is situated off-road with the gated entrance being shared with the townhouse next door, it is also fully staffed with housekeeper and cook. The upper level of this carefully designed home features three ensuite bedrooms and a wide covered terrace; the master suite also has a private ocean-facing balcony.

On the lower level, a stylish, a fully equipped kitchen with breakfast bar adjoins with dining and living areas, all of which open onto a wide covered terrace with lounging furniture. One of the most beautiful features is the sky-blue plunge pool hidden under tall coconut trees. This space is optimal for pure relaxation, afternoon cocktails and quality time with loved ones.

name: Smugglers Cove 3
description:
Welcome to Smugglers Cove where classical Caribbean architecture meets today’s demand for elegance and style. The Smugglers Development is located at the quieter end of Payne’s Bay on the platinum west coast of the Island. This exclusive and low-density development offers spectacular unobstructed sea views and is located on arguably the best beach in Barbados offering a beach bar, safe swimming and water sports, all within a short walk of the World-famous Sandy Lane Hotel.

Smugglers Cove 3 consists of 3-bedrooms each with ensuite bathrooms and a powder room for guests.  There is a fully equipped kitchen and a covered terrace with uninterrupted direct views of the spectacular Caribbean Sea. It’s the ideal spot just to relax or have breakfast, lunch and dinner al fresco with friends and family while enjoying the beautiful sunsets.

The gardens at Smugglers are beautiful, mature and full of tropical flowers, along with a small communal lap pool which all residents may use.

name: Imagine
Sugar Hill - Halfway Tree Villa
description:
Half Way Tree is a beautiful villa within the prestigious Sugar Hill resort. Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac, the villa is tranquil and private and offers amazing outdoor lounging and entertaining space.

With a popular ‘reverse living’ design, the villa is setup with the open plan living, dining and kitchen areas on the upper level, taking full advantage of natural light and breezes and opening on to a beautiful patio. The 5th bedroom – presently a convenient little nook/study – is also on this level.

The master bedroom and one guest room are on the lower level and both lead on to a covered terrace to the pool deck beyond. The spacious master room is en-suite with a fantastic walk-in closet. The other two guest rooms are in the cottage, easily accessed from either the pool deck or by private path from the parking area. The cottage is self-sufficient with its own kitchen and lounge area.

Slightly set back from the pool, the beautifully finished gazebo is a heavenly place to lounge, dine and entertain! Framing this villa are the lush and mature gardens.

Sugar Hill offers excellent amenities including a Club House with a pool and restaurant, on-site concierge, gym, tennis and 24-hour security.

name: Glitter Bay 304, Golden Sunset
description:
An elegantly furnished and recently renovated 3-bedroom penthouse situated within the spectacular Glitter Bay Estate. Glitter Bay 304 is one of the largest apartments at the beachfront property and offers two-storey luxury living, including 3 en suite bedrooms with private patios. 

Modern comforts define this space. This is seen in granite counter tops in the fully equipped kitchen, stainless steel appliances, marble bathrooms, English fixtures, air-conditioning, cable, flat screen TVs, wireless internet and more.

In terms of design, a zen-like style instantly relaxes visitors with a crisp white, beige and grey colour scheme. With plenty of windows and outdoor lounging spaces, the overall feel is peaceful and serene.

Two guest bedrooms are situated on the second floor, while the master suite with king bed is ideally placed on the ground floor. Each bedroom enjoys views of the Caribbean Sea from their spacious, private terraces.

The covered dining patio includes a glass top coral stone table for six persons and an additional seating area. From there, guests can view the manicured gardens, restaurant and turquoise waters of the Caribbean Sea.

As part of the Glitter Bay Estate, visitors at Golden Sunset can enjoy the convenience of a gated community, ample parking, swimming pool, gym, beach bar, full-time security and management services. The property also includes a Housekeeper/Laundress.

Check out is 11:00am.

Towel policy: Beach towels are available for use during your stay. Register in the office and receive your towel tokens, these can be redeemed for towels from the Beach Butlers.

Towels can be exchanged daily and the tokens should be returned at the end of your stay. Lost towels or tokens will be charged at BDS$50 per towel.
features: Close to amenities on the West Coast

name: Merlin Bay 2, Eden on the Sea
description:
Eden on the Sea is a part of the sought-after Merlin Bay estate within the private, serene and secure Merlin Bay community, located within the exclusive area of The Garden, St. James. A gorgeous three bedroom semi-detached townhouse, set on three levels with unobstructed, magnificent and breathtaking ocean views. Guests have direct access to the beach via steps leading from the villas’ private sun terrace, complimented by a large communal lagoon-style swimming pool and BBQ, a private plunge pool, ocean side showers and gorgeous gardens and grounds.

The living room, formal dining room and well-equipped kitchen which includes, (fridge/freezer, toaster, coffee machine, mixer, blender, and electric kettle) are located on the first floor, opening on to the private rooftop terrace with great views out to sea. Guests can relax in the tastefully decorated sitting room and entertain in the formal dining area. There is also a second dining area on the terrace, with views across the central pool.

One of the ensuite guest bedrooms is located on the ground floor, while the second ensuite guest bedroom and the ensuite master bedroom are located on the third floor. The master Suite benefits from a private balcony, with beautiful sea views.

The amenities of the West Coast are within a few minutes' drive, including restaurants, shops and services.
features: Can be rented with a cook/chef

name: Merlin Bay 1, Oceans Edge
description:
Merlin Bay 1 or Oceans Edge, one of eight villas at the elegant and private Merlin Bay Resort in The Garden in St James is positioned right at the ocean’s edge and is the only one with a really private beachfront garden and a wooden deck. This split-level townhouse with the entrance on the middle level has wonderful beach and sea views from all three levels.  The floors are natural Stone throughout and all bathrooms are fitted with granite worktops and vanity units.

The main level consists of an open-plan fully equipped kitchen with granite worktops. The dining and living area flow out to the patio with a private plunge pool, overlooking the garden and the sea beyond.

On the upper level are two air-conditioned bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms both having showers - including the master suite which leads out to a terrace and also has access to the rooftop terrace.

The lower floor accommodates the third air-conditioned bedroom with ensuite tub & shower and doors opening onto the patio area with Oceans Edge very own private plunge pool including patio furniture and again the sea views are spectacular. The housekeeper’s room and laundry facilities are also located on this level.

The amenities of the West Coast are within a few minutes' drive, including restaurants, bar/nightclubs, shops, supermarket, duty-free shopping, financial  services and  Lime Grove Lifestyle Centre.

name: Caira House
description:
Its aesthetics are clean, sleek, and sophisticated. Its location is ideal and picturesque.

Caira House is a 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home sitting on an acre of land with neutral tones, recessed lighting, spacious air-conditioned rooms, and modern finishes. Walk into a fully furnished home that has ready functionality, luxury, and comfort. Enhancing this fabulous property is an outdoor entertaining area, complete with a full wet bar and barbeque.

This home is just a 2-minute walk to Mullins Beach.

Although the property abuts the main road, privacy and seclusion are guaranteed with spacious grounds which provide an envelope for the house and separation from ongoing traffic. Gorgeous, manicured grounds and a beautifully presented driveway all add to the curb appeal for this home.

name: Salt Life at Claridges
description:
Claridges is an exclusive, intimate and luxurious residential boutique Development on the West Coast.  It  is set amongst two acres of lush, tropically landscaped gardens, located in the heart of the Platinum West Coast only a few moments from the secluded, white sandy beaches of Gibbs.  Designed by renowned architect Michael Gomes, it combines modern living with classic coral stone elegance and a hint of Balinese architectural influence. Finishes include beautiful cedar, mahogany, marble, granite and travertine, each complementing the other, coming together to produce a natural, stylish and classically contemporary living space.

Salt Life at Claridges is the epitome of contemporary living in the tropics. This two story, three bedroom Barbados holiday home boasts a modern interior with a fully equipped kitchen. The townhouse has open plan living and dining area as well as a den/office. All three bedrooms are en-suite with King sized beds, walk through closets and private balconies. In addition, the outdoor space includes a covered terrace with lounge area and a pretty garden patio with daybeds and alfresco dining.

The boutique resort, made up of only 10 villas, features a large swimming pool with waterfalls, sun loungers and a central gazebo where you can relax with friends and a cocktail. Claridges is a short walk to Gibbs Beach where you can hire beach chairs and umbrellas.
features: Semi private beach access to Gibbs Beach
Swedish Hot Tub and Heated Wooden Spa Pools
Close to amenities: 8 minute drive from Holetown
Large free form pool with attractive waterfall feature

name: Glitter Bay 102, 49 Steps
description:
Apartment 102, affectionately known as 49 Steps is located on the ground floor of the prestigious Glitter Bay Resort, on the Platinum West Coast of Barbados. Having been renovated to the highest standard, this two-bedroom, two-bathroom condominium is the epitome of island-inspired luxury and relaxation, perfectly suited for discerning guests.

The open-plan kitchen and living area offer seamless flow onto an expansive covered patio via large glass doors. From the patio, guests are afforded hassle-free access to the large communal pool, lush gardens, and the beautiful beach. 

The master bedroom with ensuite bathroom and double vanity offers views of the garden and direct access to the covered patio. The second bedroom outfitted with two twin beds, can be prepared as a king upon request, and serviced by the guest bathroom.

49 Steps also provides the comfort and convenience of air-conditioning and ceiling fans throughout. It is also equipped with kitchen and laundry appliances, including a mini dishwasher and washer/dryer.

Complete with modern finishes and décor throughout, this space offers a luxurious holiday experience and the best of island life!

Glitter Bay Estate is truly the perfect choice for those wishing to experience a vacation that combines the serenity and peace of the beach, while being near world-class restaurants, golf, and shopping centres.

name: Royal Westmoreland, Cuckooland
description:
Welcome to Cuckooland, a luxury 4-bedroom, 4.5bathroom villa located in the prestigious gated resort at Royal Westmoreland in Barbados. A stunning standalone home with a guest cottage, one of the most desirable Barbados vacation rentals on the island’s West Coast.

As you step through the doors, you immediately feel at home, as the entrance flows from the courtyard to the spacious living room and opens onto the pool terrace where you can spend your days basking in the sun, sitting at one of the comfortable seating areas or dine al fresco style.

Guests of Cuckooland Villa enjoy full resort privileges, including access to the golf course, beach club, fitness center, and exclusive dining venues. There is also social access to Fairmont Beach Club.
