name: Rock Ridge
description:
Welcome to Rock Ridge! Just a mere 10 minutes’ walk to the renowned Gibbs Beach in St. Peter.

This two-storey villa has two bedrooms on the ground floor with the master suite occupying the entire first floor. An open plan kitchen leads to the covered dining terrace and lounge, both located poolside. Having plenty of room to enjoy the outdoor space with its extensive covered terrace perfect for entertaining, al fresco dining or simply reading a book soaking up the tropical breezes.

This detached villa in a quiet residential neighbourhood near a wide array of west coast amenities, including several beautiful beaches, supermarkets, banks, shopping centers, the Limegrove Lifestyle Center, night life, fast food restaurants and fine dining.

Rock Ridge is your typical Caribbean living styled villa, spacious with plenty of outdoor space, great for entertainment, it opens to a beautiful free-form swimming pool amidst tropical gardens. The outdoor & indoor spaces have recently been upgraded to include the additional amenities:
features: 10 Min walk to world famous Gibbs Beach
Cook or Chef services available (extra cost)
Beautiful indoor and outdoor living spaces
Close to fabulous west coast Restaurants

name: Saint Peter’s Bay 210
description:
Experience the epitome of Caribbean luxury in this stunning 3-bedroom beachfront residence, perfectly positioned on the second floor of the prestigious Saint Peter’s Bay resort. Offering effortless access to the resort’s expansive lagoon-style communal pool, this exquisite home blends refined elegance with the relaxed charm of island living.

Beautifully designed and tastefully furnished, the residence features three spacious en-suite bedrooms, a fully equipped kitchen, and a convenient laundry area - providing all the comforts of home with the feel of a five-star escape. The open concept living area flows out onto a generous private terrace, ideal for alfresco dining while taking in uninterrupted views of the sparkling turquoise sea.

As a guest of Saint Peter’s Bay, you’ll also enjoy access to an array of premium amenities, including an onsite beachfront restaurant, a state-of-the-art gym, and a tranquil yoga and wellness studio. Whether you’re looking to indulge in fine dining, maintain your fitness routine, or simply unwind in peaceful surroundings, everything you need is right at your fingertips.

Perfect for families or couples seeking a stylish and serene getaway, this exceptional beachfront retreat offers the ultimate in luxury, comfort, and convenience.

name: Merlin Bay 3, Hibiscus
description:
Hibiscus is a lovely Mediterranean-style villa, boasting stunning beach views and offering the same privacy, seclusion and luxurious escape as all the other villas located on the exclusive Merlin Bay Resort. With two floors and a private plunge pool this villa is the perfect place for gazing out to sea and enjoying the most spectacular Caribbean sunsets.

There are three lovely airconditioned bedrooms at Hibiscus. The ground floor features a guest bedroom with ensuite bathroom, a well-equipped kitchen, an indoor dining room with sunken living area with floor to ceiling doors that lead to a small open-air terrace out to a private plunge pool.

Positioned on the upper floor is the master suite with an intimate balcony, along with an additional guest suite and a dining terrace, all enjoying lovely views over the large central swimming pool to the tranquil aquamarine waters of the Caribbean Sea.

Guests can enjoy the shared swimming pool or take an early morning sea bath and bask in the tropical heat on the stunning, pristine, white sandy beach, just a few steps from Hibiscus. The property provides direct access, via a private stairway, to a stunning beach offering excellent swimming and snorkeling.
features: Can be rented with a cook/chef

name: Merlin Bay 6, Firefly
description:
Merlin Bay is a delightful Mediterranean-style beachfront development located within the exclusive area of The Garden, St. James. Firefly is one of just eight townhouses surrounding a lagoon-style swimming pool, and offers lovely views of the aquamarine waters of the Caribbean Sea. The beach is just a few steps away from the townhouses' private sun terrace, complimented by a plunge pool and BBQ.

Its split-level floor plan features an en suite bedroom, kitchen, dining room and sunken living room on the ground floor, as well as an open-air terrace with private plunge pool. The master suite, with intimate balcony and en suite bathroom, as well as an additional guest bedroom are located on the first floor of the townhouse.

Set amid lush tropical gardens designed to offer a high degree of privacy, Merlin Bay has a stairway providing direct access to a stunning beach below, ideal for swimming and snorkelling.
features: Can be rented with a cook/chef

name: Merlin Bay 5, Ocean View
description:
Welcome to Ocean View - an exclusive split-level villa, with three floors, plus a private terrace with a distinctively Mediterranean design, Ocean View is a fantastic option for a stylish family getaway on the West Coast of Barbados! The villa is unique in that it features a stunning landscaped private beachfront garden, complete with a wooden deck offering shady, peaceful areas to relax and unwind. A private and secluded getaway!!

Ocean View has a lovely indoor dining room and sunken living room with floor to ceiling doors that lead onto the terrace and plunge pool. The kitchen is well-equipped, and includes a fridge/freezer, toaster, coffee machine, mixer, blender, and electric kettle.

On the ground floor, there is one spacious bedroom which opens onto the plunge pool and terrace. On the upper floor, the master bedroom boasts a private terrace, whilst a third bedroom also opens onto a dining terrace. Each bedroom has a charming ensuite bathroom, to offer all guests a comfortable stay. The en-suites are carefully decorated, to be in-keeping with true island living.

Guests can enjoy the shared swimming pool where sun loungers and palm trees await. The pristine white sandy beach is just a few steps from Ocean View, where guests can take an early morning sea bath, and bask in the tropical heat.

name: Merlin Bay, Gingerbread
description:
Merlin Bay offers a unique and luxurious complex of several stunning private beachfront villas to choose from in the elite St James neighbourhood at “The Garden”. Surrounded by breath-taking scenery, each with a private plunge pool. The Merlin Bay complex offers a peaceful, spacious communal area, with a beautifully kept communal swimming pool and gardens. Enjoy island living with the ocean on your doorstep – snorkel with fish, turtles, explore the coral reefs, and relax on the white, sandy beach.

Gingerbread is a beachfront, 3-bedroom villa set on three floors with a private plunge pool, enjoying fantastic sea views with steps leading to the beach, as well as a large lagoon-style communal pool, together with the lush gardens of the exclusive and private enclave that is Merlin Bay.

Enter Gingerbread on the living/dining level, there is a well-equipped kitchen and commanding, unobstructed sea views with access to the well-landscaped gardens, main pool, and the sea. With four private terraces (Including the private roof terrace) which all overlook the sea and garden, they are perfect for relaxing, entertaining, or socializing and dining with friends and family.

On the upper level, you will find the master bedroom with a sitting terrace with views of the Caribbean Sea and the second and third Bedrooms all with ceiling fans for your added comfort.

The complex is set in a fabulous location, just a short bus ride or walk away from all the main attractions / sights, restaurants, shops, clubs, and more. Enjoy all that the West Coast of Barbados has to offer with a beautiful beachfront getaway in an idyllic location – simply perfect for a family trip or romantic retreats.

name: Coral Cove 5, Shutters
description:
Coral Cove occupies approximately 100 feet of prime beach frontage just a few minutes from Sandy Lane. This desirable location is intimately set in luxuriously landscaped gardens with beautiful, aged mahogany trees and a private entrance to the beach. Coral Cove is comprised of 12 exclusive luxury apartments and two stunning penthouses designed by the renowned architect Roldano Bellori.

‘Shutters’ features 3 beautiful bedrooms, 2 of which have luxurious en suite bathrooms. An additional third bathroom is situated adjacent to the twin bedroom and available to friends during luncheons or al fresco dinners. The interior living space has been stylishly appointed to the highest standards and offers a modern, fully stocked kitchen.

The apartment’s design ultimately focuses on outdoor living, affording spectacular views of the sparkling Caribbean Sea from its spacious and totally private balcony with Jacuzzi pool, where your gaze is immediately drawn to the sapphire waters and stretches of fine white sand hugging close to Coral Cove’s beautifully manicured gardens. 

Coral Cove is centrally located on the West Coast and within walking distance of several popular beach bars, fine dining restaurants and boutique shopping. It is also within short distance of The Sandy Lane Hotel and Golf Club. 

Additional Information:

Cordless phone in kitchen

Located on Paynes Bay Beach

Safe only in master bedroom

ADSL speedL DSL megs 1024.256 K

Energy saving air-condition system

First floor within Coral Cove development

Two twin beds can either be used jointly as a King bed or separately
features: Covered terrace with Jacuzzi spa tub
Private beach front location with sea views
Close to Sandy Lane Hotel & golf course
Water sports, beach bar & restaurant nearby
Close proximity to famous fine dining restaurants
Gated development with CCTV cameras & 24hr security

name: Coral Cove 4, Green Fields
description:
Coral Cove is a very stylish set of 12 exclusive luxurious, spacious apartments designed by the renowned architect Roldano Bellori. Built to the highest quality and centrally located in Payne’s Bay on the very popular desirable West Coast, within walking distance of several popular beach bars, fine dining restaurants, boutique shopping, The Sandy Lane Hotel and Golf Club & The Royal Westmoreland golf clubs.

It occupies approximately 100 feet of prime beach frontage, set in beautifully landscaped gardens with a variety of foliage, aged mahogany trees and a private entrance to the beach, just a one-minute walk from the apartment.

Coral Cove 4, Green Fields is a luxurious 2,481 square foot 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom, first floor, beachfront apartment focusing on outdoor living, with spectacular views of the sparkling Caribbean Sea from its spacious private balcony with a sizeable jacuzzi large enough for 6 people, where your gaze is immediately drawn to the sapphire waters and stretches of fine white sand almost touching the beautifully manicured gardens.

The interior living space comprises a spacious living room with flat screen cable TV, styled with sophisticated decor of the highest standard and offers a modern fully equipped kitchen, perfect for groups, families with children or couples who want a romantic get away with a taste of paradise.

The deluxe king bed master suite has glass doors leading out onto the balcony with spectacular views, and the ensuite limestone bathroom is complete with two basins, a sizeable bath and walk in shower.  The queen bedded second room has an ensuite limestone bathroom and walk in shower.  The twin bed third room (which can be converted into a king bed) is spacious and comfortable. All bedrooms are air conditioned with additional ceiling fans.

Additional Information:

Closest beach: Paynes Bay

First floor within development

Two twin beds can be joined together to make a King bed.

Jacuzzi: private up to 6 people

Fitness: cross trainer machine, gym mats and free weights available on the balcony for guests to keep fit with a spectacular view of the sea.

name: Westmoreland Hills 35
description:
Discover Westmoreland Hills 35, an exquisite haven perched on the platinum coast of Barbados within the exclusive Westmoreland Hills 5-star gated community, boasting breathtaking panoramic vistas of the Caribbean Sea.

This luxurious villa unfolds across one meticulously designed level, offering a total of 4 bedrooms to accommodate up to 8 guests, each featuring its own ensuite bathroom. Dive into the private pool, surrounded by a spacious covered terrace, and enjoy the convenience of amenities like Wi-Fi and air conditioning throughout. Housekeeping services are provided once every 7 days, ensuring a seamless and relaxing stay.

The villa's spacious open-plan living area seamlessly blends a flat-screen TV, a breakfast island, and a lounge area connected to a fully equipped kitchen, creating an ideal space for family and friends to gather and unwind.

Large bespoke folding doors open onto the terrace, extending the indoor living space to the outdoors. Here, you'll find an inviting outdoor dining area, a lounge space, sun beds, and the infinity pool - a perfect setting to savor a rum punch while relishing the stunning sunset.

There are two master bedrooms which have comfy king-size beds, ensuite bathrooms and access to the terraces with sea views. Bedrooms three and four both offer twin beds that can be joined as king and ensuite bathrooms.

Beach Membership - This villa also benefits from Fairmont Royal Pavilion Beach Membership!

Location - Westmoreland Hills, a carefully crafted luxury gated community featuring 45 villas with night security, offers a large communal swimming pool with loungers, a grab-and-go cafe, and a well-equipped air-conditioned gym.

The elevated position of the development guarantees stunning sea views from all tiered villas, providing the perfect balance between proximity to the West Coast's beaches, restaurants, and attractions and a serene retreat away from the bustling Holetown.

Within a mere 5-minute drive, you'll reach the West Coast's fine beaches, restaurants, beach bars, Massy supermarket, and more. Golf enthusiasts will appreciate the proximity to Royal Westmoreland and Sandy Lane's Golf Courses, both just a short drive away.

Your convenience is further ensured with parking space for 2 vehicles in front of your villa, while guest parking is available near the clubhouse, where you'll also find the gym and communal area.

Westmoreland Hills is a secure enclave monitored 24/7 by security personnel and CCTV.
features: Beach Membership at Fairmont Royal Pavilion

name: Port St. Charles 167
description:
Port St. Charles Resort is located on the North-West coast of Barbados and recognized as a premier Caribbean marina, offering luxury lifestyle and convenience to owners and guests alike.

Unit 167 is a newly renovated ground floor unit, offering 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, accommodating up to 6 guests.

This prime lagoon-front location provides unbeatable views of the marina and a private plunge pool, offering the best in water-front living with a spacious private deck - the perfect space for lounging and outdoor dining.

All three bedrooms are spacious and beautifully finished, each complete with their own ensuite bathroom, offering privacy and convenience for you and your guests. The modern kitchen is fully equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, sleek countertops, and large shutter windows offering views of the outdoor space, allowing you to interact with your guests while making your favorite meal.

As a guest at Port St. Charles, you will also gain exclusive access to a suite of on-site amenities including tennis courts, gym, private beach access, beauty salon, water taxi for beach and pool transfers, as well as Pier One Restaurant, which offers tasty meals, a poolside bar service, sun deck lounging, and live entertainment on occasion.
features: Water Taxi for Beach and Pool Transfers

name: Westmoreland Hills 45 - Sundowner Villa
description:
Sundowner Villa is located in the exclusive gated community of Westmoreland Hills. Situated at the top of a hill it boosts the best panoramic views of the Caribbean Sea and sensational sunsets. This stunning four-bedroom villa, each with its own en-suite bathroom is furnished with traditional Island decor from the renowned Archers Hall Design Centre and is fully air-conditioned throughout.

Downstairs you will find the fully equipped open-plan kitchen & cozy seating area, the large floor-to-ceiling glass bi-fold doors open out to an additional covered sitting and alfresco dining area with the large private infinity pool with sun loungers.

Each spacious bedroom has an en suite bathroom. The master and queen bedrooms open onto a balcony where you can enjoy your morning coffee, and relish in the 180-degree views before starting your day. The master bedroom is the most generous-sized bedroom, with a large walk-in shower and walk-through wardrobe area. The top floor would be bedroom 3 with another king-size bed. Bedroom 4 with a queen size bed is situated on the entry level of the villa.

There is a laundry room with a washer and dryer for guest’s use and 2 full days of housekeeping during your stay.

Residents also enjoy exclusive access to the Westmoreland Hills Recreational Area, featuring a fully equipped air-conditioned gym. This expansive facility includes a communal pool complete with sun loungers and umbrellas, a designated children’s swimming section, a seasonal café, and separate changing rooms with shower facilities for both men and women.

Convenient access to the prestigious Fairmont Royal Pavilion Beach Club, just a short 5-minute drive away, complete with onsite parking and a beachfront restaurant. Members benefit from complimentary use of sun loungers and umbrellas, as well as discounted pricing on food and beverages at the beach club restaurant.

Sundowner Villa is located nearby to world-renowned golf courses such as Sandy Lane Country Club and the golf course at Royal Westmoreland.

The upscale Lime Grove Mall in Holetown, featuring an array of high-end restaurants, designer boutiques, jewelers, and specialty shops. Nearby, Clifton Market offers convenient access to a mini mart, while the charming Chattel Village of traditional shops adds a local flair. For extensive shopping needs, the expansive Massy Superstore provides a diverse selection of products, including imports from the UK and locally sourced items.

name: Chateau de Mar
description:
Chateau de Mar is a charming 5-bedroom holiday rental villa located on the beautiful West Coast of Barbados. This stunning property offers a serene and luxurious retreat, situated just 10 steps away from the azure waters of the Caribbean Sea. With its uninterrupted views of the sea, Chateau de Mar provides the perfect setting for an unforgettable vacation experience.

As you enter through the main gate, you'll be greeted by lush tropical gardens that immediately create a sense of tranquility. The pathway leads you up to the main house and pool deck, where you'll find a spacious and open-plan living area. The living area seamlessly flows into a fully equipped kitchen, allowing for easy meal preparation and entertaining. The kitchen is stocked with modern appliances and all the amenities you'll need to enjoy your stay. Your stay will include a housekeeper to ensure your villa is spotless throughout your stay.

The main house features four well-appointed bedrooms, each designed with comfort and relaxation in mind. These bedrooms provide ample space and privacy for all guests, ensuring a peaceful night's sleep. The decor is tastefully chosen, combining elements of Caribbean charm with modern elegance.

In addition to the main house, Chateau de Mar offers a delightful standalone cottage with its own bedroom. This cottage provides a secluded retreat for those seeking a bit of extra privacy or a romantic getaway. It is beautifully furnished and offers a cozy and intimate atmosphere.

One of the highlights of Chateau de Mar is its outdoor spaces. There are two designated patio areas, one for dining and the other for seating offering breathtaking views of the ocean. These spaces are perfect for al fresco meals, lounging with a good book, or simply enjoying the cool Caribbean breezes. The private pool deck provides a refreshing oasis for guests to relax and soak up the sun.

The villa's location is truly exceptional, with its proximity to Little Good Harbour and The Fish Pot. Guests can easily access these popular spots, which offer delicious dining options and beachfront relaxation. Whether you're interested in exploring the local attractions or simply unwinding on the beach, Chateau de Mar's location is ideal for both relaxation and adventure.

Another notable feature of Chateau de Mar is its flexibility in accommodating different group sizes. The villa can be rented as a 3, 4, or 5-bedroom option, making it suitable for families, couples' getaways, large groups, and even corporate or yoga retreats. The property's spacious layout and well-designed spaces ensure that everyone can find their own corner of paradise.

In conclusion, Chateau de Mar is a stunning 5-bedroom holiday rental villa in Barbados that offers a combination of luxury, comfort, and natural beauty. With its proximity to the ocean, breathtaking views, and flexible accommodation options, it is the perfect choice for those seeking an unforgettable vacation experience in this Caribbean paradise.

name: Ascot 3 Villa
description:
Ascot 3 Villa is a beautiful traditional style, very open and inviting villa, located a stones’ throw away from the spectacular Gibbs Beach, and a short drive to all other West Coast amenities such as shopping, supermarkets, banking, several other beaches, and golf.

There is no shortage of space for family and friends to enjoy every aspect of their vacation at Ascot 3, and this includes your family pet, as the entire property is fully enclosed.

This beautiful family home is surrounded by lush gardens, and landscaping with spacious covered patios, that wrap around the entire west side and is also placed on the east side of the villa, amazing high ceilings that ensure that the villa remains cool all year round, large bedrooms, and bathrooms, and living areas, and a fully outfitted and well-equipped kitchen area, that any great cook will enjoy.

There is one bedroom on the main level with an ensuite bathroom, the other three bedrooms are on the upper level with ensuite bathrooms, all cooled by AC units. Although, this is not where you will be spending much time, as it will either be by the private pool, the oasis of the garden areas, lounging on one of the patios, or most definitely on the nearby beaches.

name: Mullins Bay Townhouse 6, Jasmine
description:
Jasmine at Mullins Bay is a stunning three bedroom and three-bathroom villa located on the prestigious West Coast of Barbados, steps away from Mullins Beach.

This beautifully furnished townhouse which sits within the exclusive Mullins Bay Development can accommodate up to seven guests comfortably. The three-storey layout features a living area, well-equipped kitchen and private roof deck with spectacular Caribbean Sea views. The villa also offers a shaded dining terrace, with a BBQ, and a private terrace complete with wet bar.

In addition, the grounds include beautifully manicured gardens and a communal swimming pool. Mullins Bay is located across the road from Mullins Bay Beach, one of the most popular beaches on the island. In addition, the villa has beach membership at the Fairmont Royal Pavilion where guests have access to sun loungers, water sports and the beach club restaurant as well as the in-house hotel restaurant.

Guests also have access to Singita Wellness Spa which is a few steps away, within Mullins Bay Development and includes: Unlimited classes, Gym Access, Poolside Relaxation and 10% off all treatments (Subject to 4 guests at a time).
features: Royal Pavilion Hotel Beach Club Membership

name: Schooner Bay 306, Penthouse
description:
Located in the Schooner Bay Development, this well-appointed two-storey penthouse apartment offers an idyllic beachfront living experience. The floor plan, encompassing 3,322 sq. ft., has three air-conditioned bedrooms with opulent ensuite bathrooms featuring marble tiling throughout. The master and main guest bathrooms feature twin sinks, baths, and separate corner showers.

From the master suite, astonishing sea views can be viewed from the terrace featuring a barbecue grill and beautiful sun lounge area. Quality can be seen throughout the apartment from the finishes to the decor and even on the large wrap around terrace.

A low density building with just four floors, results in higher ceiling heights than are typically found in newer West Coast developments, enhancing the luxuriously airy atmosphere. The large, covered terrace runs adjacent to the living room, providing lovely sea views as well as attractive views of the communal pool and gardens. It has plenty of space for family dinners, sunset cocktails or simply relaxing.

name: Royal Westmoreland, Royal Villa 1 - Swansway
features: Includes a very large private swimming pool
One of the few Royal Villas to afford sea views

name: Royal Westmoreland, Sugar Cane Ridge 19
description:
Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room. Sugar Cane Ridge 19, set within the World-Renowned Royal Westmoreland, this villa offers unobstructed views of the golf course and out to the island’s coastline. Sit back and relax by your own private pool or enjoy some laps.

Featuring an open plan living and dining area, private pool and outdoor dining terrace, this property is ideal for family holidays and island retreats. The Master suite offers a King size bed, en suite bathroom and direct access to the pool deck. Bedrooms 2 and 3, also located on the ground floor share the second bathroom with Bedroom 2 offering a Queen size bed and Bedroom 3 offering two trundle twin beds. The 4th bedroom: located on the entry level of the property, offers an en suite bathroom and Queen size bed.

Guests at Sugar Cane Ridge 19 benefit from full Royal Westmoreland membership.

name: Waterside 301
description:
Welcome to Waterside 301 located on the exclusive platinum west coast of Barbados. Offering comfort, functionality, this fully furnished 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment also contains an open plan living / dining with a fully equipped kitchen leading out to a covered terrace and stunning beachfront sea views over Paynes Bay.

The apartment is fully air-conditioned and includes ceiling fans to the living areas as well as the terrace. The master bedroom has an ensuite bathroom while the second bathroom is shared by the other 2-bedrooms.

The Waterside development offers its residents all the benefits of its sought-after tranquil and secluded beach frontage. With breathtaking views of the calm Caribbean Sea and exquisite sunsets, enjoyed from your terrace and the white sandy beach, only a few steps away. Together with 24-hour security and CCTV coverage, concierge services, code-access entry, underground parking facilities, Waterside offers everything you could need for a truly relaxing break.
features: Easy Access to West Coast Amenities

name: Westmoreland Hills 47
description:
Offering panoramic sea views within this new luxury private gated community. Westmoreland Hills will become your family’s home away from home for many years to come.

You will enjoy stunning views and afternoon sunsets while sipping on Bajan Rum Punch, lounging in your private pool, with the sun on your face, and the breezes at your back.

Full open plan lets you enjoy everyone’s company until it is time to retire for the night, to rest and rejuvenate for the following day.

Maximum capacity of 6 people.

name: Westmoreland Hills 25
description:
Offering panoramic sea views within this new luxury private gated community. 25 Westmoreland Hills, will become your family’s home away from home for many years to come.

You will enjoy stunning views and afternoon sunsets while sipping on Bajan Rum Punch, lounging in your private pool, with the sun on your face, and the breezes at your back.

Full open plan, lets you enjoy everyone’s company until it is time to retire for the night, to rest and rejuvenate for the following day.

name: Glitter Bay 306, Princess Suite
description:
The Glitter Bay Estate consists of beautifully appointed apartments nestled within lush gardens on one of Barbados' stunning west coast beaches. It is here that you will find the exquisite Princess Suite, named after the two Princesses that owned the apartment when it was first built.

This 3 bedroom penthouse comprises of two floors and features an open plan fully fitted Italian kitchen and sumptuous sitting area which flows out onto a covered dining area offering amazing views of the tropical gardens, swimming pool and Caribbean Sea.

The bedrooms are all air conditioned with ceiling fans and have flat screen TVs with Satellite and DVD players. Each has been furnished to the highest standard with its own unique style - Bedroom One is Japanese style with a king-size bed, marble bathroom with walk-in shower and a large balcony.

Bedroom two is Chinese style with twin four-poster beds, en suite with large wet-room all in marble and large balcony with superb sea views. Bedroom three is the master suite and is in New England style with super king-size bed, ensuite bathroom with a large bathtub/shower and balcony with splendid views over the white sandy beach.

The living room is also fitted with a music system, an i-pod docking station and wireless internet connection.

Glitter Bay has many fabulous amenities to enjoy such as a daily Concierge; complimentary beach/pool loungers, umbrellas and towels; beach attendant; 24 hour security; drinks/snack bar; tennis courts; swimming pool and fitness room.

name: Westmoreland Hills 4, Villa Michael
description:
Westmoreland Hills 4, Villa Michael is a newly built (2022), minimalistic 3-bedroom villa situated across one level on the stunning West Coast of Barbados.

The villa is sophisticatedly furnished with a black and white monochrome concept with hints of gold pieces and decor and provides top-class upgrades such as air-conditioning throughout the entire home and a supersized 26’ private swimming pool for your use and comfort.

The simplistic yet elegant bedrooms all have air-conditioning, ceiling fans and fitted wardrobes.  The air-conditioned master bedroom has a ceiling fan, holds a king bed and has an en-suite bathroom with double sink vanity and shower.

The two air-conditioned guest bedrooms carry two sets of twins which can be joined if needed.  A shared bathroom with a shower and vanity is available for use for this bathroom and guests.

The spacious, open-plan kitchen and air-conditioned living room take in breathtaking Caribbean Sea views and even more remarkable sunsets.  The Villa also offers an upgraded fridge with water and an ice maker.  The living room has a flat-screen TV, along with ceiling fans in both this space and the kitchen.

The covered terrace is one of sophistication with its top notch decor and classy pieces which can be seen in the images. The covered terrace has a comfy lounge set plus an alfresco dining table.  As you walk closer to the pool, lounge chairs are lined perfectly for soaking up the sun.

Development and Location:  Westmoreland Hills, a small luxury gated development of 45 villas, with night security, has a large communal swimming pool with loungers, a grab-and-go cafe and a well-equipped air-conditioned gym.

The elevated position of the development means there are sea views for all of the tiered villas.  You're also close to the West Coast, but still inland enough to have space around without being directly in the hustle and bustle of the popular Holetown.

You are within a 5-minute drive to the West Coast with all of its fine beaches, restaurants, beach bars, Massy supermarket and everything else in between!  Not to mention you're a stone's throw away from Golf at Royal Westmoreland and a 7-minute drive to Sandy Lane's Golf Courses.

There is parking for 2 vehicles in front of your villa and guest parking by the clubhouse where the gym and communal area are located.

There are two gated entrances to the development. Villa Michael is located closer to the side entrance.  The development is monitored 24/7 by security and CCTV.
features: Within 5 min Drive to West  Coast

name: Royal Westmoreland, Royal Villa 7
description:
Royal Villa 7 is a well-maintained villa located in the world-renowned Royal Westmoreland Golf Estate. This villa comes complete with housekeeping, dedicated villa manager and 24hr security. The development features, communal pools, world championship 18-hole golf course, clubhouse with pro-shop, tennis courts, restaurant, and bar.

Upon entering this split level, fully detached villa, Bedroom 3 is located to the right, whilst the remaining 2 bedrooms are located on the lower level via stairs on the left. At the entrance, guests will be led to the open plan living/dining area, with the kitchen tucked away just behind. This area boasts high pickled tray ceilings, ceiling fans and double doors which open onto a covered terrace allowing for constant cooling breezes. From the upper level, one will enjoy beautiful views over the pond, lush gardens, and the Caribbean Sea.

The spacious ensuite bedrooms are all air conditioned and equipped with ceiling fans. The large master suite is located on the ground floor with king-sized bed, tub and shower and is equipped with a flat screen television and Apple TV. This bedroom has direct access to a sun terrace overlooking the resort's tranquil pond and gardens. The second guest bedroom, also situated on the ground floor includes twin beds, ensuite bathroom with shower and access to a recessed covered terrace for added privacy. This area leads right onto the Master bedroom's shared sun terrace enjoying the same views over landscaped gardens and a serene pond. The third bedroom, with queen-sized bed is located on the first floor and offers comfortable accommodation for guests.

Social Membership: Included (Access to gym, communal pool, tennis courts,  and the Royal Westmoreland Beach Club)

Villa guests staying in villas with ‘Social Membership” are asked to register for houseguest cards at the Club House.

Guests have access to the RWM facilities and Beach club with the exception of the golf course.

Social Members are required to pay to golf at the applicable rates and tee off times are available between 10:00 am and 11:00 am only.

Additional Information:

Housekeeping hours: 3 days/week 9:00 am - 3:00 pm

Two twin beds can be used jointly as a king or separately

Non-smoking villa

Nespresso coffee machine

Sonos bluetooth sound system

Closest beach : Colony Club
features: Serene views over the pond & gardens
Short walk to communal swimming pool
Enjoy sea views from both the lower & upper level

name: Mullins Bay Townhouse 19, Happy Returns
description:
This elegant 4-bedroom townhouse forms part of the Mullins Bay community and offers luxurious family accommodation in an ideal location. The villa offers a private courtyard and a communal swimming pool, as well as access to the Royal Westmoreland Beach Club at Mullins beach. There is a lockable gate between the courtyard and the pool to ensure peace of mind for parents with young children.

The villa is positioned opposite the stunning Mullins Beach known for its clear, pristine waters and popular beach bar. Relax and enjoy fine dining at the Sea Shed, The Lone Star Restaurant and The Fish Pot or explore the nearby marina with watersports and yacht charters at Port St. Charles Marina. Also in proximity are several additional amenities, such as, luxury boutiques, golf courses, and wellness spas.

Additional Information :

Air-condition unit has energy saving system

Housekeeping increases to 5 days if they are 5 or more guests

Two single beds can be used jointly as a king bed or separately

  Gym is an additional cost
features: Mins. to Speightstown and several amenities

name: Royal Westmoreland, Sugar Cane Mews 1
description:
The Sugar Cane Mews is the most recent development of houses within the beautiful Royal Westmoreland Estate. It allows you easy access to the clubhouse and is next to the first tee and short game practice area. The Sanctuary pool and gym, tennis court and Rum Shak bar are also just a short stroll away.

This location has unobstructed sea views with a desirable south-facing aspect. It also has views over the championship golf course really making this the location to be in. Sugar Cane Mews 1 is in the ideal spot!

On the ground floor, there is a master suite with a luxury en suite bathroom. There is also a large sitting area which opens up to the garden. Here you will find the pool and terrace area. These are accessed via floor to ceiling sliding glass doors.

Two additional guest rooms each with their own en suite bathroom are also on this level. A fourth en suite master guest bedroom of equally generous proportions is provided on the mezzanine floor.

On the first floor, large floor to ceiling glass sliding doors opens up the elegantly modern living and dining areas. These lead to a covered, south-facing terrace overlooking the private pool. From here the unrivaled fairway and sea views can be enjoyed to their fullest.

Sugar Cane Mews 1 has social membership.

name: Schooner Bay 305
description:
Located in the heart of charming Speightstown, Schooner Bay 305 is a beautifully appointed three-bedroom residence within a private, gated beachfront community on Queen Street. From the moment you enter, you're greeted with breathtaking ocean views that carry through the open-plan living space and both bedroom suites, offering a true sense of coastal luxury.

The well-equipped kitchen flows seamlessly into the spacious living and dining area, which opens onto a covered patio overlooking the lush, landscaped gardens, communal pool, and the sparkling waters of Barbados' west coast. It's the perfect setting for al fresco dining, morning coffee, or sunset cocktails.

All three bedrooms are air-conditioned with ensuite bathrooms and ceiling fans for added comfort. The primary suite features a king-size bed, a large ensuite with both a soaking tub and separate shower, ample closet space with a safe, and direct access to the main patio with spectacular sea views. The second bedroom also enjoys sea views, a queen bed, walk-through closet, and a private ensuite.

Schooner Bay 305 is just steps away from one of the island’s most beautiful beaches and within walking distance to an array of local restaurants, cafes, and shops. Whether you’re exploring the vibrant culture of Speightstown or enjoying a peaceful day by the sea, this home offers the best of relaxed Caribbean living.

Additional features include on-site parking and 24-hour security, ensuring both convenience and peace of mind during your stay.

Policy:

Non-Smoking

No Pets allowed

name: Royal Westmoreland, Sugar Cane Ridge 5
description:
This beautiful well-appointed, 4 bedroom gem of a villa, nestled in the exclusive development of Royal Westmoreland features 4 comfortable and tastefully decorated bedrooms. It is designed with a blend of island and modern style. The first en-suite bedroom is located on the mid level off the main entrance which leads up to the living area as you enter the villa, with the other three bedrooms being located downstairs with the master bedroom and second bedroom both opening on to the pool deck. It’s the perfect spot to sunbathe or enjoy a cooling dip in your own private plunge pool.

The open plan living and dining area can be found on the upper level of this holiday rental villa, leading out to a spacious covered balcony where guests can relax. The modern kitchen is well equipped, with everything at your fingertips to make your holiday in Barbados relaxed and enjoyable.

Sugar Cane Ridge 5 enjoys  Social Membership at Royal Westmoreland.

Villa guests staying in villas with ‘Social Membership” are asked to register for houseguest cards at the Club House.

Guests have access to the RWM facilities and Beach Club with the exception of the golf course.

Social Members are required to pay to golf at the applicable rates and tee off times are available between 10:00 am and 11:00 am only.

name: Schooner Bay 106, Dreamweaver
description:
Schooner Bay 106 - Dreamweaver is a luxurious, two-bedroom apartment situated at the spectacular Schooner Bay on the West Coast of Barbados, just a short walk from the historic and culturally rich Speightstown.

Ideally located at beach level, with views of the sea, the dining and sitting terraces are just a step away from the tropical gardens, a superb free form pool and the jacuzzi. Schooner Bay is located on a magnificent beach where the swimming and snorkeling are excellent and very safe.

This light and airy, 1,864 sq. ft. apartment offers unsurpassed quality and elegance. It is fully air conditioned and features marble floors throughout, coral stone accents and quality fittings.

The large, comfortable, sitting room is beautifully furnished in cool Caribbean tones and has wide sliding doors opening onto the terraces. The master bedroom and en suite offers a king size bed, jacuzzi bath, a large shower, twin basins and a walk-in closet with safe. French doors lead onto a terrace and garden. The second bedroom and en suite also has a king size bed which can be unzipped into two singles if required.

The stylish Italian kitchen is very comprehensively equipped with quality appliances, cookware and tableware.

Policy:

No Pets allowed

Non-smoking

name: Schooner Bay 204
Schooner Bay 401, Electra
description:
Electra is a spacious 2-bedroom apartment located within the luxurious Schooner Bay development. Located on the third floor, it offers stunning views of the free-form swimming pool, lush tropical gardens, and Caribbean Sea beyond. There is also a lovely roof terrace with a Jacuzzi pool, BBQ and sitting area where you can enjoy alfresco dining and starlit cocktails.

Decorated with a simple, yet elegant decor, Electra features central air-conditioning throughout. The open-plan living area is equipped with a large television, DVD player and cable; it opens on to the dining terrace via sliding glass doors. The kitchen is fully fitted with stainless steel appliances. The two bedrooms feature marble tile ensuite bathrooms; the master suite has a king-sized bed, and the guest bedroom has a queen-sized bed. There is an additional powder room in the entrance hall.

Amenities include a housekeeper for 3 days a week and laundress services; a cook is available at an additional fee. Schooner Bay has an onsite gym as well as 24-hour security. Speightstown, located just a short walk from the development, offers a host of restaurants, waterfront cafes and casual bars, as well as a supermarket, banks, and quaint shops.

Located on the beach, Schooner Bay residents enjoy direct access to the white sands and aquamarine seas of the island's west coast.

CHILDREN UNDER 12 ARE NOT ALLOWED
features: Attractive roof terrace with BBQ, table & Jacuzzi pool
Close to waterfront cafes, banks, supermarket, shopping & more

name: Schooner Bay 201, Flamboyant
description:
Schooner Bay is one of the most luxurious beachfront condominiums on the exclusive west coast of Barbados. The development is set on a secluded beach in a wonderfully picturesque setting and the apartments have been completed to the highest standards. The landscaped grounds include a free-form swimming pool in glorious gardens with direct access to the beach.

Available for rental is Flamboyant, a delightfully attractive two-bedroom apartment. Its dining balcony and main rooms have fabulous views directly overlooking the Caribbean Sea. The villa has been interior designed to the highest standard and expresses sophistication and comfort with its specially made fine furnishings, murals and glorious Caribbean artwork.

While staying at Schooner Bay you can enjoy a range of activities which include relaxing in the jacuzzi, getting fit in the gym and swimming in the free-form pool or the tranquil waters of the Caribbean Sea. The poolside and beach are complete with sunbeds exclusively for Schooner Bay use.

Watersports may be enjoyed, for a fee, by arrangement with Cobblers Cove Hotel, a short walk away, which also boasts an excellent bar and restaurant.

Schooner Bay 201, Flamboyant, is ideal for an exclusive, relaxing holiday in an island Paradise setting.  

Policy:

There is a child restriction.

No Pets allowed

Non-smoking

name: Sugar Hill A19, Gemini
description:
Gemini A-19 is a tastefully decorated 4-bedroom 4.5-bathroom semidetached villa nestled in the picturesque grounds of the Sugar Hill resort in beautiful sunny Barbados.

When entering the property, you step into a spaciously open plan living and dining area with lovely high ceilings. A modern kitchen with high end finishes and top of the line appliances including a full-size fridge/freezer and electric oven, there’s even a separate drinks fridge to hold your chilled bottles of champagne to enjoy whilst watching the sunset. The living room flows out onto a large balcony which offers beautiful views of a tranquil Barbados and the ocean beyond.

This beautiful town house offers four bedrooms, the first located on the entrance landing and two master bedrooms on the ground floor with their own access to the private pool deck and plunge pool. A further bedroom can be found in the properties detached cottage which also includes a kitchenette, en suite facilities and its own private patio. All bedrooms are fitted with air conditioning and fans.

Barbados is all about outdoor living, so the pool area is the perfect place to sit back and enjoy some sun or taking a relaxing dip in the private plunge pool. There is also direct access to the Sugar Hills ever expanding communal lawn where you can take a blanket and enjoy the open space for a family picnic.

All holiday guests staying at Gemini get to enjoy Sugar Hills beautiful grounds and safe surroundings within this privately gated community. Sugar Hill has an on-site restaurant overlooking the breathtaking waters of a large infinity pool with views of the sea in the distance. There is also a 2nd communal pool, tennis courts and a gym for any sports enthusiasts.

Beach club access to Fairmont Beach Club included, with complimentary loungers and umbrellas.

name: Coral Cove 1
description:
Coral Cove 1 features 2 en suite bedrooms and a guest bathroom; the interior living space is stylishly appointed to the highest standards, affording spectacular views of the sparkling Caribbean Sea and direct access to Paynes Bay Beach.

Coral Cove occupies approximately 100 feet of prime beach frontage just a few minutes from Sandy Lane. This desirable location is intimately set in luxuriously landscaped gardens with beautiful, aged mahogany trees and a private entrance to the beach. Coral Cove is comprised of 12 exclusive luxury apartments and two stunning penthouses designed by the renowned architect Roldano Bellori with a focus on outdoor living.

Coral Cove 1 features 2 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms; the interior living space is stylishly appointed to the highest standards, affording spectacular views of the sparkling Caribbean Sea from its spacious and totally private balcony, where your gaze is immediately drawn to the sapphire waters and stretches of fine white sand hugging close to Coral Cove’s beautifully manicured gardens.

Coral Cove is centrally located on the West Coast and within walking distance of several popular beach bars, fine dining restaurants and boutique shopping.  It is also within short distance of The Sandy Lane Hotel and Golf Club.

name: Royal Westmoreland, Royal Villa 12
features: Private Beach Access at Mullins Bay Beach Bar

name: Royal Westmoreland, Sugar Cane Ridge 4
description:
This is a well-appointed, modern Caribbean villa, nestled in the exclusive Royal Westmoreland Golf Resort in Barbados. The elegant split-level holiday home features four comfortable and tastefully decorated bedrooms and can sleep a maximum of eight adults.

The first bedroom is en-suite and is conveniently located on the mid-level as you enter the spacious villa. Going down to the lower level of the villa, the exquisite en-suite master bedroom has a peaceful ambiance and opens onto the private plunge pool deck. The second bedroom also opens onto the pool deck and has the same rustic feel that is present throughout the entire villa and shares a bathroom with cozy bedroom three.

The glistening private plunge pool is the perfect spot to sunbathe or enjoy a cooling dip.

An open plan living, and dining area can be found on the upper level of the villa, leading out to a spacious covered balcony where guests can relax and enjoy a delicious Barbadian meal, dining alfresco.

The modern kitchen is fully equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, beautifully balancing a sleek modern look with the warm ambiance of the villa.

Housekeeping is included, making sure that everything you need is at your fingertips to ensure your holiday in Barbados relaxed.

Guests benefit from membership at The Fairmont Royal Pavilion where you can effortlessly trade your pool and deck for the soft sands and blue waters a favourite for many visitors. Choose to snorkel or swim with vibrant tropical fish and turtles or relax in the warm Barbados sun.

Please note ongoing construction within the development.

Social membership:

The member and family have full access to the facilities with the exception of the golf course.

Social members would pay to golf and there is a limit of 12 times per year (the year runs from 1st February to 31st January).

Villa guests staying in villas with Social membership, still have to register for houseguest cards and have access to the facilities as well.

With reference to golf for guests residing in the villa, tee off times are available only between 10:00 am and 11:00 am daily and they are allowed to play 4 games per year per person. The Visitor Golfer green fee would be applicable.
features: Close to West Coast Restaurants/shopping/Night Life

name: Limegrove Villa No.7
features: Minutes’ walk to Several West Coast Beaches
3-5 Mins from Holetown and all the amenities

name: Royal Westmoreland, Forest Hills 25
description:
Nestled within the exclusive confines of the Royal Westmoreland Golf Resort in Barbados, Forest Hills No. 25 stands as an epitome of tranquillity. This three-bedroom villa boasts an exquisite blend of Caribbean elegance and modern comfort, promising an unparalleled experience for those seeking a vacation rental in this prestigious location.

Situated amid meticulously landscaped gardens, Forest Hills No. 25 offers guests an awe-inspiring vista that stretches from the serene lake to the azure expanse of the Caribbean Sea. It's not just a villa; it's a sanctuary where you can unwind, rejuvenate, and create timeless memories.

Architecturally designed on two levels, this villa showcases thoughtful planning that maximizes both privacy and aesthetics. On the ground level, you'll discover the master bedroom and a guest bedroom. These spaces have been designed to ensure your comfort, featuring ensuite bathrooms and full air-conditioning in the bedrooms, along with soothing ceiling fans.

As you ascend to the upper level, you'll find an open-concept layout that encompasses the kitchen, living, and dining areas. The design seamlessly integrates indoor and outdoor living, allowing the breathtaking vistas to become a part of your daily experience. Whether you're preparing a gourmet meal, lounging in the elegantly appointed living area, or savouring a meal with loved ones, the upper level offers a harmonious blend of functionality and style.

For added privacy and versatility, Forest Hills No. 25 includes a detached private guest cottage in the front courtyard. This space houses the third bedroom, providing guests with an exclusive retreat amidst the lush surroundings.

One of the many highlights of this villa is its proximity to a generously sized communal pool within the Forest Hills cluster, just a few steps away from your doorstep. Whether you're seeking a refreshing swim or simply want to bask in the Caribbean sun, the pool area provides an ideal spot to relax and socialize.

As a guest at Forest Hills No. 25, you'll enjoy all the access to the extensive amenities offered by the Royal Westmoreland Resort. From golfing on the world-class course to indulging in fine dining at the clubhouse, a vacation on Royal Westmoreland is nothing short of extraordinary. Additionally, you'll have the exclusive opportunity to unwind at the Royal Westmoreland Beach Club at Mullins Bay, adding a touch of beachfront luxury to your Barbadian escape.

Forest Hills No. 25 redefines the concept of a vacation rental on the Royal Westmoreland Golf Resort. Its design, stunning surroundings, and access to resort amenities create an unforgettable retreat in one of Barbados' most prestigious locations. Whether you're seeking a romantic getaway, a family vacation, or a group gathering, this villa sets the stage for an exceptional Caribbean experience that will linger in your memories for years to come.

name: Sugar Hill A16, Sugar Plum
description:
Welcome to A16 Sugar Plum, a cozy 3-bedroom semi-detached villa nestled in the prestigious Sugar Hill Resort on the stunning West Coast of Barbados. This charming, light-filled retreat features a dipping pool on the ground level, and stunning Caribbean Sea views on the upper-level.

The elegantly furnished living and dining area opens to a spacious terrace, with its own dipping pool, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living. With multiple sitting and dining areas, it’s perfect for entertaining, while the various terraces offer inviting spaces to relax and enjoy al-fresco meals.

Each of the three bedrooms is air-conditioned, beautifully decorated, and has its own en-suite shower room. The primary suite, located on the upper level, boasts a private balcony with breathtaking views making it a perfect spot for morning coffee or evening sunsets.

Sugar Hill is a private, gated community sprawled across 50 acres with stunning views of the Caribbean Sea. Just a short drive away, you'll find the pristine beaches of the West Coast, as well as the vibrant amenities of Holetown, including shopping, banking, nightlife, and an array of excellent dining options. Guests at A16 Sugar Plum enjoy access to the Sugar Hill Clubhouse, restaurant, pool, fitness center, & tennis courts.

A16 Sugar Plum is the ideal choice for a luxurious island getaway - combining comfort, elegance, and easy access to everything you need for a perfect holiday!

name: Westmoreland Hills 1, Villa Savannah
description:
Welcome to Villa Savannah where your luxury vacation in Barbados begins.  Situated within a gated community, just across the road from the well renowned Royal Westmoreland Golf Resort, is Westmoreland Hills.

Villa Savannah, Westmoreland Hills  is one of the newest additions to the development having been completed in 2022.  This well-crafted home is the first in a line of 15 other one-level villas.  However, this end unit has additional upgrades for added comfort.

This stunning villa boasts 3 spacious bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and is designed with the highest quality materials, fixtures, and furniture. The primary bedroom is a gem, the owners have opted to expand the space. It features a king-sized bed, with an additional seating area with a sleeper sofa to comfortably accommodate two additional people (at US$50 per person per night), perfect for hosting guests. The bedroom also has a flat screen smart TV, cupboards and an ensuite large bathroom with a walk-in shower featuring a rain shower head and a handheld shower.  There is also a stylish double vanity for added convenience.

The first of the 2 other bedrooms has a queen bed.  The other guest room features two twin beds that can be joined if needed. These bedrooms share a bathroom with a walk-in shower.   All bedrooms have air-conditioning (AC), ceiling fans and cupboard space along with trendy decor and accent pieces.

Have no worries about running out of clothes to wear, as a washer/dryer is conveniently concealed and tucked away discreetly in the hallway.

Entering the open concept living room and kitchen, the villa continues to amaze. The view out to the covered terrace, sun terrace, swimming pool and ultimately, the sea is breathtaking.  The living room has a cozy sofa, 85” flat screen Smart TV, cable TV with USA channels at your fingertips, sound bar and an AC unit. The kitchen includes all major appliances as well as additional luxuries such as a Vita-mix, air fryer, kettle and a coffee maker.

Under the covered terrace you’ll find dining tables and an outdoor lounge area.  Chic chaise loungers are located just in front of the expansive 26-foot upgraded swimming pool. Floaties are available for your use for added fun in the sun.

Wi-Fi is included, and boosters have been placed through the home to ensure easy living and connectivity while on vacation.  A security system is in place with door cameras (which can be activated if you choose), otherwise this will remain off.

Westmoreland Hills is a boutique luxury gated community.  It is monitored 24 hours with round the clock security.  There is a large communal swimming pool with loungers, a well-equipped air-conditioned gym and a grab and go café.

The villa is in a comfortable location, with breathtaking sea views.  It’s a short drive to the west coast where all amenities can be found, from dining, bars, cafes, shopping, theatres, clubs, banks, supermarkets and more! Let’s not forget the close proximity to the amazing beaches of Barbados!

Don’t miss this opportunity to indulge in the comfort and luxury of our boutique styled Villa.
features: Within 5 min Drive to West  Coast

name: Royal Westmoreland, Palm Ridge 2A, Heavenscent
description:
This elegant, well-maintained 4 bedroom home has been tastefully finished in coral and natural woods, and is complemented by an open plan layout and high vaulted ceilings, giving the property a light and airy atmosphere.

The pool deck and terrace offer comfortable outdoor living and entertaining, with spectacular views of the Royal Westmoreland Estate. This desirable location will also position guests and residents within close proximity to alluring beaches, boutique shopping, fine dining restaurants and all amenities along the West Coast and nearby Holetown.

name: Sugar Hill, Coconut Shell
description:
Sugar Hill is an exclusive Gated Resort with an impressive range of amenities and communal facilities all monitored by 24-hour manned security for added piece of mind. Owners and guests can enjoy facilities, such as, a club house, 2 swimming pools (an infinity edge, overlooking the west coast and the other a free form with waterfall and shallow children’s area), a fitness gym, floodlit tennis courts, a restaurant and concierge desk.

Coconut Shell, a luxurious private Villa is nicely positioned in an elevated, breezy section of the beautifully, tropical landscaped grounds in Sugar Hill. The Villa has 3 air-conditioned bedrooms with the master bedroom with ensuite bathroom situated on the ground floor. Ascend the spiral staircase to the first floor which accommodates the second bedroom also with ensuite bathroom and a third bedroom with the bathroom located just next door. All three bedrooms have their own private terrace.

There is a modern well-equipped kitchen and a comfortable sitting room leading to a large terrace which is perfect for outdoor dining.

Sugar Hill is within a 5-minute drive of the famous platinum west coast with its picturesque beaches, boutiques, and fine dining.

These rates include the Fairmont Beach Membership and housekeeping 3 days per week when occupied.

name: The Falls Townhouse 4
description:
The Falls Townhouse 4 has been beautifully furnished with 3 en suite bedrooms fitted with air conditioning and ceiling fans. The en suite bathrooms are equipped with marble vanities and either baths or walk-in showers.

An Italian kitchen and open plan living area which has been fitted with a/c, leads onto a private covered terrace with outdoor dining, providing the perfect spot to relax, eat and drink with friends and family.

The Falls development is like no other on the island, bringing together one of a kind townhouses and villas in an enclosed environment, complete with a community clubhouse with swimming pool, sun bathing deck and exercise room. There is also 24-hour security for sound peace of mind.

Located at the social epicentre of the famed West Coast of Barbados, The Falls is within minutes of world-renowned restaurants. Slip away from your tropical haven to the renowned Sandy Lane Beach relax on pristine white powder sands and swim in the warm waters of the Caribbean Sea. You can even indulge in a spell of celebrity watching. Paynes Bay Beach is also nearby, about 15 minutes walk, offering a lively beach bar, water sports and sun chairs for hire.

In nearby Holetown, located within 15 to 20 minutes walk of The Falls, residents can also enjoy private beach access at The Beach House, which also offers a swimming pool, sun beds and umbrellas and a beachfront restaurant and bar. The area also offers a wonderful selection of amenities and conveniences such as Italian coffee shops, fashion boutiques, duty-free shopping, banks, police station, post office, public library and a supermarket.

Additional Information:

Communal pool: 15 w x 32 h x 4ft deep

Membership: The Beach House with pool bar, restaurant and sun beds

The on-site clubhouse is euipped with bathrooms with showers, TV with access to cable, seating area, fitness room and the communal pool.

The fitness room includes a treadmill and two exercise bikes.
features: Beach access at The Beach House
Walking distance to Sandy Lane Beach
Within walking distance to restaurants in Holetown
Communal club house with pool, bar & fitness room

name: Glitter Bay 213
description:
Glitter Bay 213 is located on the second floor in the Bougainvillea block of Glitter Bay resort and recently underwent a complete renovation.

With two bedrooms and two bathrooms, the unit can comfortably sleep up to 4 guests, or 5 by special request, in which case a roll away cot can be provided. The kitchen and living area are both spacious with ample seating and there is a covered balcony, which is accessed via sliding glass doors. This outdoor space looks onto the large, shared pool, lush gardens, as well as the beautiful West Coast Sea.

The master bedroom is equipped with a king-sized bed and ensuite bath with a double vanity and access to the balcony via another set of glass doors. The second bedroom has two twin beds and there is a second bathroom located in the hallway with a combined shower and tub for added convenience.

The unit also has A/C and ceiling fans throughout and is equipped with all appliances including a mini dishwasher and washer/dryer.

Glitter Bay Estate is truly the perfect choice for those wishing to experience a vacation that combines the serenity and peace of the beach while being near world-class restaurants and shopping centers. With the recent renovation, we wanted to combine the luxury of the West Coast with the raw and relaxed nature of the Caribbean.

The bohemian-style décor, along with the creative use of raw materials and textures really captures the essence of "island life” and is sure to set the mood for a luxurious but relaxing retreat!
features: Walking Distance to West Coast Amenities

name: Waterside 303
description:
Apartment 303, situated on the second floor, is a spacious 2-bedroom apartment that has been nicely furnished and finished to an exceptional standard. Both bedrooms have ensuite bathrooms and personal closet space. The open plan living/dining and kitchen area peers out onto the sea, facing the dining terrace. The apartment affords sea views and includes all necessary amenities for a wonderful holiday such as high speed WIFI, cable TV, oven, stove, microwave, dishwasher, washer, dryer and more.

Guests have access to the communal pool deck with complimentary lounge chairs and umbrellas, on-site equipment which is free of charge and an underground parking garage with easy access to the apartment via an elevator.

Located in Paynes Bay on the West Coast, Waterside offers its guests an idyllic setting in a tropical paradise, with all modern amenities close at hand. The popular Holetown area is a mere 5 minutes north of the development, with its supermarkets, banks, duty-free shopping facilities and boasting some of the island’s best restaurants, from the affordable to the exclusive. Water sports are available within a few minutes' walk and several world-class golf courses are just a short drive away. The world famous 'The Cliff' restaurant is a short walk away, while Daphne's restaurant is even closer. The Sandy Lane Hotel is a comfortable stroll up the beach. The development is set back from the main road, ensuring peace and privacy while on vacation.

Exterior:

Secure walled gate development has underground car parking with own space.

Keypad and remote controller access to the gate and doors with intercom link to phones in the apartment and at the concierge.

Main entrance doors to two staircases and lifts via a large coral rendered and marble tiled lobby.

Otis lifts to all floors including the car park.

Common area and car park fire alarm system linked to the Security office.

Meranti hardwood doors, windows, and shutters.

CCTV cameras linked back to security.

Modern designer pool over 30m long with spacious sundeck.

Indigenous mature plants frame the perimeter of the site.

Interior:

Meranti hardwood timber paneled doors, frames & architraves.

Glazed doors on to private terraces with travertine tiled floor and skirtings.

Marble tiled floors & skirting throughout the apartment with marble wall tiling to all bathrooms & shower rooms.

Vitreous China bathroom sets with chrome fittings and taps.

Wash hand basin mounted on marble vanity tap with mirrored cabinet over and GFCI socket nearby.

Coral rendered entrance hall and living room with white silk finish walls and ceilings to the bedrooms.

Coral cornicing to perimeter of all rooms.

Comfort cooling to living and bedrooms using individual A/C units and ceiling fans.

Hardwood fitted wardrobe louvred doors and cabinets to bedrooms.

Extractor fans to bathrooms, shower rooms, cloakrooms, and kitchen.

Cable TV and telephone are all connected and ready for use.

Broadband connections to all apartments are available ready for use.

Kitchen :

Open plan designed hardwood floor & wall units with peninsula or island breakfast bar onto living area.

Black Granite worktops and upstands.

Stainless steel inset sink with designer mixer/spray tap, and waste-disposal with a stainless-steel dishwasher nearby.
features: 5 Mins. Drive to Holetown Commercial Hub

name: Royal Westmoreland, Forest Hills 33, Paradise Villa
description:
Welcome to Paradise Villa!

Nestled within the prestigious world-class gated community of Royal Westmoreland golf & beach resort, Forest Hills 33 is a beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom villa that offers the epitome of Caribbean luxury. Set in the exclusive Forest Hills enclave, this elegant retreat boasts breathtaking views of the Caribbean Sea and the lush Royal Westmoreland Estate, enjoyed best from the spacious upper-level terraces where you can relax in comfort on the elegant seating and dine al fresco on the deck which incorporates and a six burner BBQ for your added  enjoyment.

Step inside Paradise Villa, the epitome of Caribbean luxury and elegance, where island charm meets modern comfort. The open-plan living, dining, and sitting areas flow seamlessly onto sun-drenched terraces—perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails with a view. The fully equipped kitchen includes all the modern conveniences you’d expect, from a dishwasher and microwave to a blender, toaster, and icemaker—ideal for preparing anything from quick snacks to gourmet meals.

Each of the three bedrooms have ceiling fans and are fully air conditioned offering a peaceful sanctuary, with the master bedroom & bedroom two featuring  private ensuite bathrooms and bedroom 3 has access to the third bathroom. Whether you're traveling with family or friends, the villa is designed to offer space, comfort, and a true home-away-from-home experience.

The private 11 acre manicured gardens of Forest Hills are for the exclusive us of the Forest Hills community and  include a substantial communal pool deck with covered areas for those who like the shade and loungers and chairs for your relaxation. There are two swimming pools, one large where you can enjoy a refreshing swim or more demanding exercise, or just relax in the crystal clear waters and a second kids pool where little ones can splash and play in the shallow waters.

To make your stay even more relaxing, our wonderful housekeeper Marcille is on hand to keep the villa pristine and take care of laundry during your visit—so all you need to do is unwind and soak in the beauty of Barbados.

As guests in Paradise Villa you have free access to the on-site facilities including, tennis, padel tennis, pickle ball, dining, air conditioned gymnasium at the Sanctuary pool deck, and exclusive beach facilities at the Royal Westmoreland Beach Club at Mullins Bay. Plus all guests at Paradise Villa benefit from discounted members guests access to the world-class Robert Trent-Jones Jr. designed championship golf course.

Paradise Villa, Forest Hills 33 promises a holiday experience that is as carefree as it is unforgettable.

Please Note: Check in time - 4:00 pm / C heck out time -  11:00 am

Full membership:

The member, spouse/partner and any children have full access to all of the facilities (Sanctuary gym, pools, jacuzzi, tennis courts, golf course, driving range and Mullins Beach Club).

Villa guests register for houseguest cards which give them access to the facilities.

With reference to golf for guests residing in the villa, the Unaccompanied Full Member’s Guest or the Twilight green fees would be applicable (or if accompanied by the member, the Member Guest fee).

Additional Information:

Safe in Master Bedroom

Wi-Fi

Closest Beach: Colony Club

name: Royal Westmoreland, Cassia Heights 8
description:
Nestled within the lush, meticulously landscaped gardens of the prestigious Royal Westmoreland Resort, Cassia Heights 8 offers an idyllic retreat with sweeping, uninterrupted views of the fairways. This newly refurbished, elegantly appointed two-bedroom split-level villa features tastefully decorated interiors, where soaring bay windows bathe the space in natural light.

The inviting deck seamlessly blends indoor and outdoor living, creating an ideal setting for both relaxation and entertaining. With two designated parking spaces, this charming villa offers both comfort and convenience, making it a perfect escape in one of the island’s most sought-after locations.

Conveniently positioned just a short 2-minute walk away from the resort Club House and Sanctuary, guests of Cassia Heights 8 are within easy reach of the large communal swimming pool and gym.

The master bedroom, located on the upper level of the property, offers a private patio, air-conditioning, a large screen television, a safe, king bed and bathroom. The guest bedroom: with a queen bed, is located on the lower level of the property and also includes air-conditioning.

The Royal Westmoreland Resort is located approximately 1 mile from the amenities of Holetown and the west coast, is 7 miles from Bridgetown, and is 12 miles from the Grantley Adams International Airport.

Explore our stunning selection of villas in Barbados. If you have your heart set on the prestigious Royal Westmoreland, take a look at our exquisite villas in Royal Westmoreland, offering unparalleled elegance and world-class amenities.

Note:

Cassia Heights 8 currently has full RWM membership.

Royal Westmoreland Golf Club is independent from the property estate and reserves the right to change club rules, including access to the course and tee times at their discretion.

name: Mullins Grove (3 bedroom)
description:
Retreat in comfort within your 1,350 sq. ft. three bed apartment suite. White on white infused with sandy wood porcelain floors and designer furnishings create a luxurious beach chic environment set amongst tropical gardens.

Mullins Grove Hotel is a mere 200 yards from the iconic Mullins Beach Bar. Being a boutique luxury self-catering hotel, guarantees each and every guest enjoys one-on-one service. On-site amenities include a fabulous architecturally designed Pool & Sun Deck, Pool Side Bar, Gym & Exercise Room, Spa Treatment Room, Games Room and Roof Top lounge area. Guests at Mullins Grove also benefit from a “special” relationship with the Speightstown Bay Restaurant Group and a complimentary taxi service.

Mullins Grove's open plan living areas with sliding & bi-folding terrace doors, generous balconies, energy efficient lighting, custom wardrobes & cabinetry with all modern appliances and natural stone work tops in the kitchens & bathrooms set the tone for a luxurious lifestyle at Mullins Grove.

name: Waterside 104
features: Access to air-conditioned to on-site gym
Ideal beachfront location with walking distance to restaurants
Communal swimming pool with complimentary pool chairs & umbrellas

name: Porters Court 7
description:
Welcome to Porters Court. This small exclusive development of 8 luxury villas with communal swimming pool and patio area furnished with sun loungers is located just minutes from a lovely west coast beach.

The Villas are completely enclosed by well-manicured tropical gardens with the only access being via security gates. The beach and inviting crystal blue waters of the Caribbean Sea are just 100 metres away and can be accessed via a path adjacent to the Lone Star Restaurant.

Villa No. 7 has been tastefully furnished to provide a comfortable and relaxed holiday home, far away from the routine of life and maddening crowd, perfect for a family or couple looking for a peaceful, tranquil, and affordable holiday on the West Coast of Barbados. For added peace of mind the property includes a safety deposit box, electric gates.

The villa has been designed with a seamless open plan layout and is air-conditioned throughout and all rooms also include ceiling fans. Fully furnished it includes linen, towels, beach towels, maid / laundress service, gardener / pool maintenance and use of the communal swimming pool and patio area with sun loungers.

For the golf enthusiasts, Porters Court is a 5-minute drive away from the Royal Westmoreland Golf Course and a 10-minute drive from the Sandy Lane Golf Course – two of the finest golf courses in the Caribbean.

Note: Fairmont Beach Club Access Cards are included .

name: Waterside 101
description:
Waterside 101 is a beautiful beachfront, executive ground floor condo located on the Platinum Coast of the island.

This luxury condo offers two air-conditioned ensuite bedrooms equipped with ceiling fans, a fully equipped kitchen and a living area with central air conditioning that opens to a cozy covered terrace, that leads to the communal pool and beach access gate.

The spacious Master bedroom is tucked away to the far left on entry and offers a king size bed and ensuite bathroom with tub and shower. Guest bedroom 1 is located adjacent to the master bedroom and provides a king size bed, that can be made as a twin upon request. Its ensuite offer a walk-in shower and single vanity.

Waterside offers guests access to a free parking, a communal swimming pool and direct beach access. Situated five minutes away by taxi to Holetown and approximately ten minutes away from our capital Bridgetown. The property is within close proximity to duty free shopping, banking, supermarkets, spas, golf, tennis and restaurants such as the famous The Cliff, QP Bistro and Positano.

name: Royal Westmoreland, Cassia Heights 29
description:
Barbados Sotheby’s International Realty proudly presents for vacation rental Cassia Heights No. 29, a luxurious semi-detached villa located in the exclusive Royal Westmoreland Golf Resort. This stunning property is set on a bluff with breathtaking views of the championship 18-hole golf course, the adjoining lake, and the Caribbean Sea beyond.

Cassia Heights 29 features three generously sized bedrooms, each with its own en suite bathroom and air conditioning. The third bedroom is situated in a tranquil self-contained cottage, offering privacy and serenity. Recently redecorated and improved by the new owner, the villa boasts modern furnishings and enhanced amenities for a comfortable stay.

The inviting lounge area opens seamlessly to a newly constructed deck, providing picturesque vistas of the sea and the charming Clubhouse below. This Barbados vacation rental offers a perfect blend of luxury and relaxation, ideal for those seeking an unforgettable Caribbean experience.

Social Membership included.

In the Area:

Royal Westmoreland Clubhouse (a short walk away)

Championship Golf Course

Mullins Beach (10-minute drive)

Holetown for shopping and dining (15-minute drive)

Local restaurants and bars
features: Close to Beaches, Restaurants, and other Amenities

name: Royal Westmoreland, Forest Hills 35, Bajan Sunset
description:
Forest Hills 35 is a private end of row, 2 bedroom villa, which benefits from Westerly sea views – this well maintained golf residence is permanently staffed by an attentive housekeeper who will look after all your needs and for added peace of mind the villas is managed by a helpful property manager who is also available to you should you have any questions during your stay.

As well as offering access to the World Class Royal Westmoreland Golf Course, staying at Forest Hills 35 also includes use of the tennis courts, private pools, gym and clubhouse with restaurant and bar.

Beach lovers will be happy to know that beach chairs and umbrellas are available at the Beach Club at Mullins, which also includes a popular beach bar and restaurants, water sports and ample members parking. 

The kitchen is fully equipped with all modern appliances, inclusive dishwasher, microwave, blender, toaster and ice maker. The living, dining and sitting areas are all located on the upper levels and lead onto terraces offering stunning sea, estate or golf course views.

The villa’s attentive housekeeper, Cecily, will ensure the villa is kept tidy during your stay, and will also manage laundry services, leaving you with the sole task of concentrating on your enjoyably relaxing holiday.

Additional Information

UK Internet TV available

Safe in bedroom 2

Tv in Master Bedroom

Closest Beach: Colony Club

name: Ashanti 3
description:
Ashanti No: 3 is a 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom apartment located on the first floor of this small, gated development situated just a stone’s throw from the popular Mullins area. Offering air-conditioned bedrooms, 6-seater dining area, and equipped kitchen.

The ensuite master bedroom is outfitted with queen size bed and has access to a small patio which looks out to the coast and sea beyond.
