Bedroom 2 with bathroom access and bedroom 3 which has an ensuite bathroom are both outfitted with queen beds and provide the option of air-conditioning or ceiling fans.

Ashanti Development although close to Mullins Beach, offers its guests access to a communal swimming pool. The Development is situated within close proximity to Historic Speightstown with all its essential services and amenities, including beaches, restaurants, shopping, banking facilities and supermarkets.

name: Sugar Hill, Jammin
description:
Welcome to Jammin, a charming, well-appointed 3-bedroom townhouse with panoramic views of the platinum west coast out to the Caribbean Sea because of its position on an elevated ridge within the prestigious Sugar Hill Resort Community. This luxurious residence sits amidst fifty acres of meticulously manicured landscaped grounds.

Jammin is fully furnished and epitomizes refined living, boasting a spacious, open plan design with a seamless flow from living to dining, easily catering too both indoor and outdoor dining areas. This provides an inviting ambiance for both intimate gatherings and lavish soirees. The kitchen is fully equipped with modern, state-of-the art appliances, making it a chef’s delight.

There are three air-conditioned, en-suite bedrooms - each a sanctuary of comfort, elegance, and absolute tranquility. Two of the bedrooms are located on the upper level while the third bedroom on the ground floor, opens to the comfortably sized private plunge pool with a spacious deck, perfect for indulgent relaxation and entertaining.

Sugar Hill resort amenities include tennis, swimming pools, gym and a restaurant in the clubhouse, a focal point within the resort and 24-hour security. In addition, it is within a 5-minute drive of several beaches, shops, restaurants, and banking facilities in Holetown.

Experience the epitome of luxury at Jammin, where attention to every detail is meticulously crafted to ensure an enjoyable, stress-free holiday in the heart of the Island.

name: Royal Westmoreland, Royal Villa 18
description:
Nestled within the prestigious Royal Westmoreland estate, this stunning semi-detached villa offers an exquisite blend of elegance and comfort, available for your next luxury getaway. With 3 impeccably designed bedrooms, this residence promises an unparalleled retreat.

Step into a world of sophistication with the villa’s natural tones and split-level layout. The expansive open plan living and dining areas feature elegant coral stone walls. This space seamlessly flows onto a spacious, partially covered terrace, complete with plush seating and a refined alfresco dining area, where you can savor stunning views of the lush tropical gardens.

The villa’s master suite, located on the ground floor, is a sanctuary of luxury, complete with a king-sized bed, a private en suite bathroom, and a cozy seating area. Also on this level, a second bedroom offers two twin beds and a private bathroom, perfect for family or guests. On the upper level, the third bedroom boasts a king-sized bed and a spacious en suite bathroom, ensuring a retreat of its own.

**This villa offers exclusive luxury accommodations and provides access to the communal pool within the Royal Westmoreland estate. However, it does not include beach club membership or access to other Royal Westmoreland amenities.**

name: Sunset Crest, Cherry Avenue 82
description:
Beautifully situated in the heart of Holetown, this charming 3-bedroom home is just a short walk from the supermarket, coffee shops, banks, bars, restaurants, the beach, and the Sunset Crest Beach Club with its communal pool.

Nestled amidst stunning gardens, the house features a master bedroom with a king bed, a second bedroom with a queen bed, and a third bedroom with two twin beds, each comfortably air-conditioned.

The inviting living and dining areas offer plenty of space to relax, complemented by a fully equipped kitchen that overlooks these spaces, perfect for preparing meals while staying connected with family or friends. Step out onto the covered patio, an ideal spot to unwind and enjoy the gentle Caribbean breeze, whether you’re savouring an outdoor dinner or relaxing inside.

Just off the master bedroom, a private saltwater pool awaits, perfect for soaking up the sun on the loungers or enjoying peaceful evenings with a glass of wine. For your convenience and entertainment, the home includes Wi-Fi and two TVs, both equipped with Fire Sticks for streaming your favourite shows.

Included in the stay: Access to the Sunset Crest Beach Club with beachfront amenities and a communal pool.
features: Access to the Sunset Crest Beach Club
Walking Distance to Shops, Restaurants, and Beaches

name: Battaleys Mews 17
description:
Escape to paradise in Barbados, where sun-kissed beaches, crystal-clear waters, and a chilled-out vibe await! Battaleys Mews is the perfect spot to soak up all the island has to offer, just a stone's throw from the lively Speightstown and only 500 meters from the stunning Mullins Beach on the Platinum Coast.

This three-bedroom unit is your home away from home, with over 2,300 square feet of stylish, spacious living. Everything you need for a relaxing getaway is here.

The open plan living and dining area make it super easy to kick back and enjoy the laid-back island life. Sink into comfy sofas, catch your favorite shows with satellite TV, or connect with friends using the free Wi-Fi. The dining area seats six, and French doors open to your private patio with a spa pool and garden—perfect for outdoor meals and relaxation.

The fully stocked kitchen is ready for your culinary adventures with a fridge-freezer, microwave, oven, stove, dishwasher, and washing machine, so you’ve got all the tools to cook up some island treats.

Upstairs, a gorgeous, curved staircase leads to the bedrooms. The 257-square-foot master suite is your personal retreat, with a private balcony to soak in the view, and a luxurious bathroom with a walk-in shower and bathtub, all wrapped in beautiful Travertine limestone. The second bedroom has a queen-sized four-poster bed, and the third offers twin beds—perfect for the whole crew! Plus, each room has air conditioning to keep you cool.

Battaley Mews Development offers a myriad of onsite amenities including a large communal swimming pool with loungers, fitness center, tennis court, clubhouse, and a children’s playground.

name: Sugar Hill B306
description:
The Palms is a tastefully furnished, two ensuite bedroom penthouse apartment overlooking one of the two pools and beautiful gardens within the exclusive Sugar Hill Estate. Located on the second floor, this approximately 1,700 sq. ft. unit also benefits from an additional private sun deck on the floor above. Complete with loungers and jacuzzi to enjoy the sun and stars, this elevated position provides panoramic views of the Caribbean and wonderful sunsets. The spacious open-plan design, set east/west allows cool breezes to blow through the property if desired with ceiling fans throughout and air-conditioning in both bedrooms. The main living area opens onto the dining terrace via French doors whilst the kitchen is fully fitted with all necessary appliances for self-catering and with an adjacent utility room complete with washer/drier. The two double bedrooms, situated at either side of the property, provide complete privacy and each feature built-in wardrobes with additional French doors to the dining terrace. Maid service is complimentary and provided on three days each week.

The Sugar Hill Estate is set on 50 acres of extremely well-maintained grounds with a clubhouse providing lovely views and with a further magnificent 2,000 sq. ft. infinity edge pool and state of the art fitness centre. There is also a children’s pool, tennis on four world-class floodlit courts and a lovely restaurant and bar overlooking the pool.

Sugar Hill has a 24-hour security patrol and checkpoint on arrival as well as an onsite management team. Located within minutes of Holetown, the property provides complimentary membership and beach access at the neighbouring Fairmont Royal Pavilion Hotel set on the magnificent Alleynes Bay. Sun loungers, sunshades, parking and a discount towards meals and drinks are also complimentary.
features: Royal Pavilion Hotel Beach Club Membership

name: Nevis Villa
description:
Nevis Villa, located within the residential neighborhood of Heywoods Estate and within walking distance of the famed and historic Speightstown, this elegant Villa sits on three levels. The high-vaulted ceilings allow for a stream of natural light and steady circulation of cool breezes which gives a feeling of comfort and relaxation.

On the first floor, there are three stunning en suite bedrooms with the master suite leading onto its own private patio.  

The second floor is an open plan living concept, great for entertaining as it features living, dining, kitchen and access to the outdoor pool and lounge areas. The newly renovated kitchen also opens to a patio overlooking the two-tiered pool deck and large private swimming pool. On the ground floor there is a double carport, laundry room and additional storerooms.

Nevis Villa also features a poolside gazebo offering an additional great area for entertaining or simply relaxing while enjoying views of the ocean.

name: Schooner Bay 108, Chilterns
description:
Schooner bay is a beachfront condominium that consists of three blocks of apartments with a freeform swimming pool as the focal point. Chilterns is a delightfully spacious one-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment with all the finishes one would expect to find in a penthouse unit, with marble floors, marble bathrooms, custom-made Italian kitchen and granite work surfaces. It is furnished with a Caribbean flavour to compliment the cool, natural tones of the floors and walls.

While staying at Chilterns at Schooner Bay you can enjoy a range of activities which include relaxing in the jacuzzi, getting fit in the gym and swimming in the free-form pool or the tranquil waters of the Caribbean Sea. The poolside and beach are complete with sunbeds exclusively for Schooner Bay use. Watersports may be enjoyed, for a fee, by arrangement with Cobblers Cove Hotel, a short walk away, which also boasts an excellent bar and restaurant. Schooner Bay 108, Chilterns, is ideal for an exclusive, relaxing holiday in an island Paradise setting.

Your stay at Chilterns will truly be a memorable one.

Policy:

No Pets allowed

Non-smoking

name: The Falls Villa 1
description:
Furnished with a Caribbean flair, The Falls Villa No. 1 has an open-plan layout elegantly finished with hardwood doors and windows, trey ceilings and pickled pine cabinetry. The Italian kitchen has granite countertops, and the luxurious bathrooms have marble vanities.

The master bedroom includes a walk-in wardrobe and ensuite bathroom; the guest bedroom is also ensuite. The main living area has French doors that open onto a private terrace with plunge pool, surrounded by beautifully landscaped gardens.

Ideal for couples or families with children, Villa No. 1 is a comfortable home away from home, offering privacy and security in a central location on the famed West Coast of Barbados. The Falls is within minutes of world-renowned restaurants including Quattro Passi at The Cliff and Cala Roca, as well as, within walking distance of The Sandy Lane Hotel. Slip away from your tropical haven to the renowned Sandy Lane Beach, relax on pristine white powder sands and swim in the warm waters of the Caribbean Sea. You can even indulge in a spell of celebrity watching. Paynes Bay Beach is also nearby, about 15 minutes’ walk, offering a lively beach bar, water sports and sunchairs for hire

In nearby Holetown, located within 15 to 20 minutes’ walk of The Falls, residents can also enjoy private beach access at The Beach House, which also offers a swimming pool, sun beds and umbrellas and a beachfront restaurant and bar. The area also offers a wonderful selection of amenities and conveniences such as Italian coffee shops, fashion boutiques, duty-free shopping, banks, police station, post office, public library, and a supermarket.

The Falls offers an extraordinary opportunity to become part of an exclusive village community right in the heart of the West Coast and adjacent to The Sandy Lane Estate. The Falls development is like no other on the island, bringing together one-of-a-kind townhouses and villas in an enclosed environment, complete with a community clubhouse with swimming pool, sunbathing deck, exercise room and bar. There is also 24-hour security for sound peace of mind.

Additional Information:

Closest beach: Sandy Lane

Communal pool: 15 w x 32 h x 4 d

Private plunge pooll: 9 w x 13.2 L x 3 ft d

ADSL speed: Mega 1024-256k

Air-condition unit has energy saving system

Membership : The Beach House with pool bar, restaurant and sun beds.
features: Beach access at The Beach House
Walking distance to Sandy Lane Beach
Within walking distance restaurants in Holetown
Communal club house with pool, bar & fitness room

name: Battaleys Mews 7 - Mullins Breeze
description:
Set amidst the beautifully landscaped gardens of Battaleys Mews, unit 7 is a tropical 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom, free-flowing townhouse which offers an open plan design, with spacious interiors and welcoming outdoor spaces.

This villa offers a fully-fitted luxury Italian kitchen, fitted with European appliances; open plan living and dining areas and access to a covered terrace complete with private spa pool. All bedrooms are situated on the first floor with the master bedroom benefitting from a private en-suite bathroom with both a bath and shower plus a private balcony. The other two guest bedrooms share a bathroom with a walk-in shower.

Battaleys Mews is ideally located between Holetown and Speightstown, both areas offer supermarkets, duty-free shopping, boutique stores, banks, post offices, bars, and restaurants. The popular Mullins Beach is just a 5-minute walk away.

name: Sugar Hill, Seabreeze Penthouse
description:
Welcome to Seabreeze Penthouse at Sugar Hill Resort, Barbados!

If you’re dreaming of a holiday rental that feels like a home away from home, look no further than Seabreeze Penthouse. Tucked away on the top floor of the beautiful Sugar Hill Resort, this two-bedroom condo is the perfect blend of comfort and style, just waiting for you to enjoy!

As soon as you step inside, you’ll feel the inviting vibe of this well-furnished space. Each bedroom features its own ensuite bathroom, so you and your guests can enjoy the luxury of privacy and convenience. Imagine waking up in the morning, sipping coffee, and soaking in the tranquil atmosphere. It’s the perfect start to your day in paradise!

One of the highlights of this penthouse is the relaxing roof deck. Picture yourself lounging under the Caribbean sun, hosting a barbecue, or enjoying an evening cocktail while taking in the beautiful views of the lush gardens and shimmering pool. And let’s not forget the sea views—there’s nothing quite like watching the sunset over the water!

Sugar Hill boasts an unbeatable location, just a quick drive away from the stunning beaches and lively atmosphere of Holetown. You’ll have access to the nearby Royal Pavilion beach, where you can take advantage of complimentary sun loungers and umbrellas, relax on the soft white sands, and swim in the crystal-clear waters. Whether you’re eager to tee off at the renowned Royal Westmoreland golf course, discover local boutiques, or savor exquisite dining experiences, everything you desire is within easy reach.

Plus, the resort offers fantastic amenities to enhance your stay. Enjoy a meal at the onsite restaurant, take a dip in the large clubhouse pool, or challenge your friends to a game of tennis on the flood-lit courts. With 24-hour security, you can relax and enjoy your vacation knowing you’re in a safe environment.

Seabreeze Penthouse isn’t just a rental; it’s your gateway to an unforgettable Barbadian experience. So, pack your bags and get ready to create some wonderful memories in this charming retreat. Whether you’re here for adventure or relaxation, this penthouse is the perfect place to call home during your stay

name: Summerland 201, Blue Haven
features: Air conditioned living room and bedrooms

name: Mullins Grove (1 bedroom)
description:
Retreat in comfort within your 786 sq. ft. one bed king apartment suite with pool deck view. White on white infused with sandy wood porcelain floors and designer furnishings create a luxurious beach chic environment set amongst tropical gardens.

Mullins Grove Hotel is a mere 200 yards from the iconic Mullins Beach Bar. Being a boutique luxury self-catering hotel, guarantees each and every guest enjoys one-on-one service. On-site amenities include a fabulous architecturally designed Pool & Sun Deck, Pool Side Bar, Gym & Exercise Room, Spa Treatment Room, Games Room and Roof Top lounge area. Guests at Mullins Grove also benefit from a “special” relationship with the Speightstown Bay Restaurant Group and a complimentary taxi service.

Mullins Grove's open plan living areas with sliding & bi-folding terrace doors, generous balconies, energy efficient lighting, custom wardrobes & cabinetry with all modern appliances and natural stone work tops in the kitchens & bathrooms set the tone for a luxurious lifestyle at Mullins Grove.

name: Westlook 2
description:
Westlook No. 2's design emphasises sleek lines, modern finishes and a neutral design palette enhanced by pops of electric colour adding visual appeal and dramatic style. Breathtaking views of the Caribbean Sea can be enjoyed from the unit, further enhancing its beautiful décor.

The two bedroom, two bathroom unit features open-plan living areas and an impressive kitchen. The most stunning feature is an amazing deck and pool area, ideal for sunbathing, refreshing swims and al fresco dining in the crisp morning breezes or under starlit skies.

The two en suite bedrooms are beautifully appointed, and the upstairs bedroom has a private veranda. The spacious living room features a flat screen TV, DVD/CD player and entertainment equipment. A pullout sofa bed offers additional sleeping accommodations. A cot and highchair are also on hand for a baby or young child.

Located within five minutes’ walking distance of the beach and a 10-minute drive from Holetown, Westlook No. 2 is within easy reach of the West Coast’s top amenities, including great shopping, nightlife and world-class dining.

Additional Information:

Closest beach: Thunderbay Bay

name: Royal Westmoreland, Cassia Heights 7
description:
Cassia Heights is a golfer’s dream; the Robert Trent Jones designed course is one of the finest in the Caribbean. Cassia Heights 7 is a modern 3 bedrooms split-level villa featuring an outdoor deck perfect for breakfast and quiet evening entertaining. Spectacular golf course views can be embraced from this villa and within just a short distance from the clubhouse, gym and communal pool.

The facilities at Royal Westmoreland offer an enviable range of amenities. The impressive clubhouse has a stylish bar and fine dining bistro offering local delicacies. The helpful staff will look after your every desire leaving you free to enjoy the spectacular views of the golf course. There is also a gym, tennis courts and a community pool.

Royal Westmoreland also has a Beach Club at nearby Mullins Beach where beach chairs and towels are provided.

Social membership:

Villa guests staying in villas with ‘Social Membership” are asked to register for houseguest cards at the Club House.

Guests have access to the RWM facilities and Beach Club with the exception of the golf course.

Social Members are required to pay to golf at the applicable rates and tee off times are available between 10:00 am and 11:00 am only.
features: Mins from several West Coast beaches and amenities

name: Coral Beach 105
description:
Coral Beach 105 is a simple modern design vacation retreat offering two-bedrooms nestled in the serene enclave of Little Battaleys, St. Peter. This ground-floor apartment boasts an inviting open-plan layout and is just steps away from a refreshing shared swimming pool, offering a perfect blend of luxury and comfort for your island getaway. Step into the bright and airy living area, flooded with natural light, where you can unwind after a delightful day of exploring Barbados.

The main bedroom is a haven of relaxation, featuring a sumptuous queen-size bed, a spacious walk-in closet, and a pristine en suite bathroom. The second bedroom has a double bed. Start your mornings with a cup of coffee on your private patio, or simply relax in the lush gardens, enveloped by the tranquil ambiance.

Coral Beach 105 is one of Barbados' finest new rentals, thoughtfully designed with quality finishes, fixtures, and appliances. The gated property ensures your privacy and security, featuring a comfortable lounging deck, a sparkling pool, a communal BBQ console, and seamless WiFi access. The outdoor space is a peaceful oasis where you can soak up the sun, mingle with other guests, or indulge in your favourite leisure activities.

Ideally located, Coral Beach 105 is near the stunning Mullins Beach and a short drive from the charming towns of Speightstown and Holetown. Discover the island’s rich cultural heritage, savour delectable local cuisine, and dive into exciting watersports activities.

name: Sugar Hill A104, Palm Breeze
description:
Located in the spectacular Sugar Hill Tennis Village, Palm Breeze is a stunning, one bedroom apartment located at the end of row on the ground floor. There are ceiling fans and air-conditioning throughout the unit.

The apartment has a well-equipped kitchen as well as washing machine, dryer and ironing board. Housekeeping services are provided once weekly. All towels are provided in the apartment, as well as towels for outdoor and pool use.

The Sugar Hill Tennis Village is set on 90 acres of extremely well-maintained grounds. There is a clubhouse with breathtaking views, a magnificent 2,000 sq. ft. infinity edge pool and state of the art fitness centre. There is also a children’s pool, complimentary tennis at four world-class floodlit courts and a lovely restaurant and bar. A members’ lounge offers satellite television and a quiet area to relax over the odd game of chess. Sugar Hill has 24-hour security patrol and checkpoint on arrival, as well as an onsite management team. Restaurant bookings, local attraction bookings and babysitting can also be arranged for you.

Located within minutes of Holetown and Royal Westmoreland, Sugar Hill also provides beach access via the neighboring Fairmont Royal Pavilion Hotel, with sun beds and umbrellas, parking and beach service.

Nespresso machine with starter pods

name: White Sands G4
description:
A wonderful opportunity to vacation in this duplex on the West Coast of the island. Located within Historic Speightstown, White Sands offers covered, allocated parking directly opposite the beach. G4 is one of the more attractive apartments and offers stunning sea views access from double French doors.

White Sands is located on the exclusive West Coast and boast an exclusive location just yards from the beach, easy access to local shops, restaurants and bars, and situated on the outskirts of historic Speightstown. This development features 2 bedroom duplex apartments that enjoy private terraces with unobstructed sea views, so play and relaxation are just moments away.

The town is only a few minutes walk from White Sands and has all the amenities you could possibly require, including banks, shops, supermarkets and several beachfront restaurants and bars. The development is just 10 minutes from Royal Westmoreland, 15 minutes from Holetown and 20 minutes from Sandy Lane, giving you the best of both worlds – a quiet haven on the edge of where it is all happening. Speightstown is recognized to be an up and coming area, with a number of high end properties and hotels in the area, including the luxury development at Schooner Bay as well as the Almond Beach Hotel and the luxury marina Port St. Charles.

Ideal Holiday Home:

The Italian Kitchens include granite counter tops, oven, hob, microwave, fridge, freezer with ice making machine, dishwasher and plenty of cupboard space. The properties are tiled throughout with Italian porcelain tiles. Naturally stained cedar wood is used on the French doors leading to the terraces, where there is room for a dining table or sun loungers. 

Those who visit Barbados love the warm breezy outdoors, and the covered terraces become the main focus of the property, ideal for sunbathing, or simply relaxing whilst watching the sun disappear beyond the horizon. There’s simply nothing better.
